g5O1YSxp-RSI-Exact-Divergence-Strategy-E.idea: Regular RSI(14) divergence between successive 5/5 RSI pivots touching 30/70, entered only with the daily EMA200 trend; opposite divergence closes the trade.

entries.condition: Bullish divergence (price lower low, RSI higher low, one pivot at or below 30) and prior daily close above daily EMA200.
Bearish divergence (price higher high, RSI lower high, one pivot at or above 70) and prior daily close below daily EMA200.
buySignal = bullDiv and htfTrendUp, plotted on the signal bar.
sellSignal = bearDiv and htfTrendDown, plotted on the signal bar.

exit.how: Opposite divergence (no HTF filter) closes the position; an opposite filtered entry reverses it.

timing.note: RSI pivots confirm 5 bars late; daily series use [1] with lookahead_off; div shapes are drawn 5 bars back.

Bj46W5Gs-liquidity-sweep-divergence-smt..idea: SMT divergence: chart asset wicks through its previous 2/2 swing high/low and closes back while a second asset (default BINANCE:BTCUSDT) fails to break its own.

entries.condition: Low sweeps previous swing low by over 0.2 ATR, close back above, swings synced, second asset makes no lower low.
High sweeps previous swing high by over 0.2 ATR, close back below, swings synced, second asset makes no higher high.

timing.note: Same-timeframe request.security on another symbol, default lookahead off; pivots confirm 2 bars late.

LIBFEE2F-Center-of-Gravity-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Ehlers Center of Gravity: negated position-weighted centroid of the last 10 hl2 values; crossing its own one-bar delay marks cycle troughs and crests.

entries.condition: CG crosses above its one-bar-delayed copy, i.e. the oscillator turns up.
CG crosses below its one-bar-delayed copy, i.e. the oscillator turns down.

exit.how: none explicit; the opposite cross is the next cue.

timing.note: Closed-bar; a cross of cg over cg[1] is just a slope change, so it fires on every turn.

LIB91008-NRTR-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Nicolas Kopyrkin's trailing reverse: a ratcheting trailing line (percent or ATR offset from trend extreme) flips the state when close crosses it; each flip is a stop-and-reverse signal.

entries.condition: State was down and source closes above the trailing line (flipBullish).
State was up and source closes below the trailing line (flipBearish).
Same flipBullish event drawn as a circle at the trailing line; needs Reversal Markers on (default true).
Same flipBearish event drawn as a circle at the trailing line.

stop.how: Trailing line (percent or ATR from trend extreme) is the stop; crossing it reverses the state.
stop.name: NRTR

exit.how: Stop-and-reverse: the opposite reversal flip closes the position.

timing.note: Flip decided on closed source (close); trailing line only ratchets. No pivots, no security.

LIB231AF-Volume-weighted-MACD-LuxAlgo.pi.idea: MACD built from volume-weighted moving averages (fast minus slow VWMA) with a signal line and histogram; alerts on signal cross, zero cross and histogram turns.

entries.condition: VW-MACD line crosses above its signal line.
VW-MACD line crosses below its signal line.
VW-MACD crosses above zero (fast VWMA above slow VWMA).
VW-MACD crosses below zero.

exit.how: Opposite signal cross implied; no explicit exit marker.

timing.note: Closed-bar crossovers; volume-weighted averages need real volume, falls back to simple mean if none.

LIB5DA68-VWAP-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Anchored VWAP (session, week or month) with standard-deviation or percent bands; line coloured by price side. Cross alerts are informational.

timing.note: Daily/week/month anchor via timeframe.change; closed-bar cross. VWAP hidden on 1D+.

iwEyBE2d-Moving-Average-Trend-Sniper-Cha.idea: Adaptive smoothed moving average with ATR glow band; line colour flips blue/orange when close crosses it. Colour only, no markers or alerts.

timing.note: Computed from closed bars only; nothing is signalled.

tGI9kmoO-Phase-Regression-Oscillator-Lux.idea: Least-squares fit of a sine/cosine to the last N closes; plots sine of the fitted phase as an oscillator with overbought/oversold lines. No alerts.

timing.note: Computed from closed bars only; nothing is signalled.

fgbYXSfz-Rising-Falling-Window-Signals-L.idea: Detects rising and falling windows (price gaps between bars) as support/resistance zones and labels an arrow when a later candle tests the zone with a rejection pattern.

entries.condition: Candle tests a rising-window (gap-up) zone top with engulfing, regular or wick rejection (default Engulfing).
Candle tests a falling-window (gap-down) zone bottom with bearish engulfing, regular or wick rejection.

stop.how: Zone edge is implicit invalidation (close beyond zone deletes it); not output.

timing.note: Labels drawn on the bar that confirms the test; zones from completed bars. Label y sits at zone edge, not at price.

4v1ExKvr-VWAP-Volume-Profile-BigBeluga.p.idea: Builds a volume profile along VWAP direction (up-VWAP volume positive, down negative) with +/-VWAP points of control; VWAP and candles coloured by VWAP slope.

timing.note: Drawn on last bar only; uses historical bars for profile.

Zq6iMAjj-Hullinger-Percentile-Oscillator.idea: Percentile position of price inside HMA-centred bands, smoothed. Swing mode trades smoothed-line turns; Contrarian mode trades band-edge crossbacks (weak and strong reversals).

entries.condition: Smoothed oscillator crosses above its value two bars earlier (turns up).
Smoothed oscillator crosses below its value two bars earlier (turns down).
Contrarian mode only: oscillator crosses up through the outer lower band.
Contrarian mode only: oscillator crosses down through the outer upper band.
Contrarian mode only: oscillator crosses up through 0 (inner lower band).
Contrarian mode only: oscillator crosses down through 100.

exit.how: Opposite swing signal implied; no exit marker.

timing.note: Signals use closed-bar crosses; divergence plots use offset -1 but are not alerted.

caro9zQE-MVRV-Z-Score-AlgoAlpha.pine.idea: Bitcoin on-chain MVRV z-score (daily, BTC_MVRV feed) shown as Heiken Ashi candles with HMA; flags band crossings and divergences. Same BTC value is applied to whatever symbol is charted.

entries.condition: Price lower low while HA z-score higher low at a confirmed pivot low (1 bar lag).
Price higher high while HA z-score lower high at a confirmed pivot high.
HA z-score crosses up through -4 (oversold edge).
HA z-score crosses up through +4 (overbought edge).
HA z-score crosses up through -2.32.
HA z-score crosses up through +2.32.

timing.note: Daily on-chain series via security (lookahead off); signals change once per day and hold across intraday bars.

mE6LGQLx-Curved-Price-Channels-Zeiierman.idea: Curved ratcheting upper/lower bands (ATR-scaled, widening with bars since last extreme) and their average as a trendline; shows a trend-strength read-out. No alerts.

timing.note: Computed from closed bars only; nothing is signalled.

7zdMTKnr-Liquidity-Levels-Sweeps-Grabs-F.idea: ICT liquidity tool: previous day and week highs/lows; flags sweeps (pierce then close back through, over bars) and grabs (single wick rejection) as stop-run reversals.

entries.condition: Prior day/week low pierced earlier, now close back above it.
Prior day/week high pierced earlier, now close back below it.
One candle wicks below level with wick >= body and closes back above.
One candle wicks above level with wick >= body and closes back below.
Same sweep event as the low-sweep alert, triangle up below bar.
Same high-sweep event, triangle down above bar.
Same low grab event, diamond below bar.
Same high grab event, diamond above bar.

stop.how: None output; wick extreme beyond the level is the natural stop.

timing.note: Prior day/week levels use [1] with lookahead_on, so fixed and safe; sweep can complete many bars after the pierce.

4XMv68nQ-Gova-s-WSA-Screener.pine.idea: Weinstein stage analysis on a chosen timeframe (default weekly, 30-bar MA): classifies stage 1 to 4 and offers alerts when a stage starts. Built as a screener.

timing.note: Security on Analysis Timeframe with lookahead off and previous confirmed bar; stage known at close.

LIBF15DB-Premier-Stochastic-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Leibfarth's Premier Stochastic: double-smoothed centred stochastic squashed to +/-1. Crosses of +/-0.2 mark directional shifts; crosses back inside +/-0.9 mark fading extremes.

entries.condition: Oscillator crosses back up through -0.9, downside momentum fading.
Oscillator crosses back down through +0.9, upside momentum fading.
Oscillator crosses up through +0.2 (leaves neutral band).
Oscillator crosses down through -0.2.

exit.how: Opposite shift or fade implied; no exit marker.

timing.note: Closed-bar crossovers on a lagging double EMA; no pivots or security.

5QtH3KYD-Multi-Layer-Volume-Profile-BigB.idea: Four nested volume profiles (300, 150, 75, 37 bars) with point of control, total and delta volume labels, drawn on the last bar. No alerts.

timing.note: Drawn on last bar only.

MBStXuFk-Jurik-Price-Bands-and-Range-Box.idea: Jurik-smoothed price with wide ATR-based macro bands plus a 200-bar range box and mid line; dashboard shows up/down trend. No alerts.

timing.note: Range box and dashboard drawn on last bar only.

gqtSuLQt-Adaptive-Resonance-Oscillator-A.idea: RSI whose period adapts to a Hilbert-transform cycle estimate, HMA-smoothed. Marks turns of the line, stronger turns out of the 20/80 extremes, and regular divergences.

Smoothed RSI turns down while the prior value was above 80.
Price lower low with higher RSI low at a pivot low confirmed 1 bar later.
Price higher high with lower RSI high at a pivot high confirmed 1 bar later.
Smoothed RSI turns up outside the 20/80 extremes (diamond).
Smoothed RSI turns down outside the 20/80 extremes.

exit.how: Opposite turn signal implied; no exit marker.

timing.note: Turn signals on closed bars; divergence pivots confirm 1 bar late (plot offset is visual only).

x3KNfmR3-RSI-Momentum-Divergence-Zones-C.idea: RSI of 10-bar momentum with pivot divergence: price lower low with RSI higher low is bullish, price higher high with RSI lower high is bearish; draws zone lines at the pivot.

RSI pivot high (5/5) confirmed, RSI lower than prior pivot within 5-50 bars, and price high higher than prior pivot high

Same bearish divergence as Bearish Label, drawn on the price chart

eJDO07bj-Hann-Window-FIR-Filter-Ribbon-B.idea: Six Hann-window FIR moving averages form a colour-graded ribbon; a cross of the first two lines draws support or resistance zones. No alerts or markers.

3gpERF3o-RSI-Prediction-by-Range-Segment.idea: RSI with history of 100-bar RSI paths grouped by starting RSI segment; on the last bar projects the average path forward as a polyline coloured by direction.

eR9y7zmm-Log-Regression-Oscillator-Chann.idea: Log-regression channel over 150 bars (stdev bands) with RSI/MFI/Stochastic oscillator redrawn inside the channel as a polyline. Visual overbought/oversold context only.

zGK0XvCC-Smooth-Cloud-BigBeluga.pine.idea: Three Ehlers SuperSmoother lines (60, 40, 20 bars); fast line crossing the slowest gives an up or down arrow signal, drawn 2 ATR(200) from the fast line.

ta.crossunder(source, JMA)

JMA slope turns from >=0 to <0

Same crossDown as Bearish Price Cross, drawn only when showSignalsInput is true (default false)

2DdGznIR-Auto-Trend-Drawing-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Simplifies the last 300 closes (ATR-normalised Ramer-Douglas-Peucker) into anchor points and draws a Catmull-Rom spline polyline on the last bar. Pure drawing.

olH8ZDWi-Candle-Body-Support-Resistance-.idea: Big candles (body above 2 ATR) set support or resistance lines at half their body; dots mark retests that hold. Lines are removed when closed through.

1TNKGfkP-Phoenix-Ascending-2-6.pine.idea: Oscillator averaging TCI, money-flow RSI and RSI (WaveTrend-style) with a red signal line, LSMA, energy histogram and pressure dots beyond 20/80. No markers.

close < LSMA - 1.5*ATR(14) and LSMA falling

e6zVkDBB-Price-Point-Volume-Oscillator-L.idea: Estimates buy/sell volume traded at the current price over the last 100 bars (by close position in each bar) and plots delta histogram and dashboard. No signals.

Same event as the alertcondition, plotchar triangle above bar

i8IAjLKw-Adaptive-Volume-Profile-v1-5.pi.idea: Builds a volume profile over the last N chart bars from lower-timeframe data and draws boxes with per-row volume and a coverage table on the last bar.

PwTdSQ3F-Volume-Range-Profile-with-Fair-.idea: Builds volume histograms in the top and bottom 30% of the 100-bar range, shows buy/sell volume totals and a drifting fair-value line from the upper-zone POC average.

LIBE1123-TPO-Profile-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Builds daily TPO letter profiles from 30-minute periods with POC, value area and initial balance; alerts on range extension beyond the initial balance and on crosses of prior-session levels.

First time in the session low drops below the initial-balance low, after the opening periods are complete.

gHHRpuHC-Change-in-State-of-Delivery-CIS.idea: ICT change in state of delivery: close beyond the open of the last opposite-colour candle run marks a trend flip (Classic), or after a swing liquidity sweep (Liquidity Sweep mode). Labels only, no alerts.

Classic: close below the open of the last bullish candle run, within max validity; label colour bearish, text has no side.

Liquidity Sweep mode only: bearish CISD after a swing-high sweep, drawn at the bar high.

wIIzTurg.pine.idea: Marks candles in three one-hour sessions (Asia, Europe, America, Shanghai time) with boxes and labels classifying volume behavior, liquidity and ATR state; a status table. Information only.

LIB2497C-Autocorrelation-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Rolling autocorrelation of returns (200-bar window, lag 1) with significance bands; flags momentum-friendly or mean-reversion-friendly regimes plus a correlogram. A regime reading, not a signal.

timing.note: Rolling window of closed-bar returns; correlogram drawn on last bar only.

LIBB5A8B-January-Effect-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Measures January returns against other months and grades the January barometer (January direction vs the rest of the year). Statistics dashboard, no trade setup.

LIB71CC6-Momentum-Expansion-vs-Contracti.idea: Reads an oscillator (default MACD histogram) as expansion or contraction phases and compares successive momentum peaks and troughs. A momentum-shape lens, not a trade trigger.

timing.note: Swing alerts lag by the 5-bar pivot length; phase alerts use current-bar oscillator values.

E4w7VtBS-Retest-Break-Setup-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: After a close breaks a swing high or low, counts K retests that hold the broken level, then prints a Break label when price closes beyond the retest extreme within N bars.

After K retests of a broken swing low, close drops below the lowest low since the break within N bars.

gHKRvMlB-Curved-Trend-Channels-Zeiierman.idea: Draws a step-based trend line with volatility bands (regular or curved mode) and optional candle colouring from line direction. Pure visualization; no alerts or markers.

timing.note: No request.security, no pivots; direction is not exposed as a marker.

RJqOaPRR-BTC-Power-Law-Ladder-Point-in-T.idea: Divides BTC price by a power-law trend line refit each January and tracks valuation rungs with a de-risk (above 2.5x) and restore (below 1.6x) rule. Daily only; a risk instrument.

timing.note: State uses barstate.isconfirmed but only on daily bars; alertconditions are not gated by valid.

LIBB1F11-Bagging-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Bootstrap ensemble of 50 k-NN models on momentum, RSI and z-score features predicts the next 5-bar direction; the averaged prediction crossing zero flips bias.

entries.condition: Ensemble prediction crosses above zero (ta.crossover(ensembleValue, 0)).
Ensemble prediction crosses below zero (ta.crossunder(ensembleValue, 0)).

exit.how: Opposite zero-cross of the ensemble; no separate exit marker.

rtqVynGv-Fibonacci-Volume-Profiles-AlgoA.idea: Draws Fibonacci retracement levels between the latest swing pivots plus a volume profile of the leg. Drawing tool only; no alerts or signal markers.

isf58Fgf-Multi-Timeframe-Supertrend-Pro-.idea: Three Supertrends (chart, confirmation, weekly) vote; a signal prints when at least 2 agree on a new direction. Intended as a consensus trend-flip entry.

Consensus flips to bear: at least 2 of 3 Supertrends bearish and previous consensus was not bear.

Same consensus_flip_bear event.

All three Supertrends bearish after fewer than 3 on the prior bar.

↓ MTF ST Pro [algotim] | Primary ST turned BEARISH

LIB95447-Volume-adjusted-Time-LuxAlgo.pi.idea: Resamples price into volume-clock bars (a bar prints when a volume bucket fills) and draws them as candles. Alerts fire when a bucket prints, coloured by close vs open.

LIBFA520-Cointegration-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Engle-Granger pairs test of the chart symbol against a second symbol; fades spread z-score crossings beyond +/-2 while the spread tests stationary, exit when z returns to the mean.

Same event as Short Spread Entry, drawn only if Show Signal Markers is on (default off).

timing.note: request.security same timeframe, default lookahead off; SPX is closed on weekends so the second leg goes stale on crypto bars.

LIB7D34A-Unfinished-Auction-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Audits each completed session for unfinished highs and lows (no excess tail, stacked TPOs or closing-bell extreme), draws them as references price tends to revisit, and flags repair.

targets.how: Unfinished levels act as destinations but no target is emitted.

timing.note: Session audited on the first bar of the next session (timeframe.change); no request.security.

kjPMckBt-Bitcoin-Power-Law-Clock-LuxAlgo.idea: Draws Bitcoin's daily log price and a smoothed average as a 4-year-cycle spiral clock with halvings and a time-and-price table. Purely a visual cycle map.

1milyM6X-Liquidity-Absorption-Engine-Str.idea: Composite score from wick absorption, liquidity sweeps and flow; a smoothed score crossing 72 (or 28) opens one long or short plan with ATR stop, three ATR targets and a DCA level.

timing.note: Signals gated by barstate.isconfirmed; no request.security despite header comment about HTF.

LIB732E1-VWAP-Pinch-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Two VWAPs anchored at the latest swing high and low converge; when price compresses between them and then closes beyond for several bars, that is a directional escape, with retests of the surviving VWAP.

Pinch active and 2 consecutive closes below the lower VWAP.

Triangle over bar on the same bar as the bearish escape alert.

After bearish resolution, high first touches the high-anchored VWAP from below.

LIB8C009-Execution-Algo-Footprints-LuxAl.idea: Scores intrabar slice uniformity, one-sided delta, pullback persistence and volume participation to flag a working buy or sell execution program; confirmed after 60 minutes and 1 ATR of span.

Footprint starts or flips: score at least 50 with net sell delta. Alert text calls it tentative.

LIBB04E8-Three-Black-Crows-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Detects three long dark candles opening inside prior bodies and closing near lows after an advance, a bearish reversal; variants add identical opens and a swing-low break, plus bounce levels.

Within 20 bars of a signal, high reaches the first crow's open: deeper bounce to sell into.

LIBCD36B-Absorption-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Tracks swing-based support and resistance zones that reject heavy-volume approaches on narrow or stalled bars; flags absorption after enough tests, confirms on a 1 ATR departure and refutes on a decisive break.

Qualified resistance zone and close more than 1 ATR below the zone bottom (level held).

zJ4hOaOp-Half-Cup-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Draws a quarter-circle half cup between the last pivot high and a new pivot low (and the inverse) with projected channel lines, and marks dots where price closes through those channels.

CDfsfyDO-Three-Session-Volume-Profile.pi.idea: Builds Asia, London and New York session volume profiles with POC, value area and optional session VWAP bands, drawn as polylines and lines for level reference.

E31jKiTS.author: WillyAlgoTrader
E31jKiTS.summary: Structural anchors define a volume-weighted leg. The 12 November v1.2.1 update requires close confirmation for retests by default and allows a three-bar reclaim window.

Priority: the enabled VM base still records September source. Import November as a separate version, verify new alerts and compare prospectively. Preserve the intentionally separate HL/LH-pivot variant and existing evidence.

hkKioUnL.author: WillyAlgoTrader

Warmup and range maturity intentionally delay signals. v2.4 limits cumulative sweep depth, resets opposite breaches and freezes relevant geometry. Keep cancellation and expiry distinct from entries. Preserve its tick and gap handling, but recalculate fees and fills independently; this is not a fully sized multi-partial exchange strategy.

ngb1s23R.author: WillyAlgoTrader
ngb1s23R.summary: STRAT candle sequences arm a trigger with expiry; independent trap setups also exist. Regime, volume and risk checks qualify the actual trade.
ngb1s23R.requirements: Structural stop, R targets and break-even. Bare pattern alerts do not necessarily mean a new position opened. Optional Full Timeframe Continuity uses forming HTF information; it is off by default and changes replay parity when enabled. Keep setup and executed model-entry events separate. Document the FTC setting in the evidence identity. Do not remove the neutral-regime filter merely to increase counts; test that alternative independently.

eQPdoeM6.author: WillyAlgoTrader
eQPdoeM6.summary: CHoCH and confirmed pivots build an impulse and corrective-wave interpretation with projected levels.
eQPdoeM6.requirements: Wave invalidation and projection updates describe a pattern; they are not an executable position lifecycle. Unfinished wave points can move. Confirmed pivots arrive after their right-hand lookback, even if labels appear earlier. Use as structure context. Ignore ended/invalidated patterns as entries. Any strategy built from these waves requires its own explicit trigger, stop, timing and evidence.

ZoccxbOB.author: WillyAlgoTrader
ZoccxbOB.summary: The public explanation describes a staged 1–2–3 reversal, an armed projection and a later confirmed trade.
ZoccxbOB.requirements: Three targets and stepwise stop management; later release notes describe a fuller exit-alert lifecycle. An armed zone can change before entry. The author’s chart results omit exchange frictions and use optimistic target ordering. Public explanation reviewed; source access is unavailable. The VM marks it removed. Do not claim code parity or activate from chart screenshots.

73fIFFEV.requirements: Wick/ATR protection with three targets, break-even and reversal handling. Entries confirm at bar close and HTF context is closed-bar based. Choppy markets can still produce repeated flips. Candidate for a distinct trend-following test. Retain the author’s trigger and geometry; compare native exits against current engine exits using identical causal fills, not dashboard hit rates.

Z4DiNsKb.requirements: No autonomous intraday entry, stop or exchange-position lifecycle. Designed around daily/weekly Bitcoin history and manually chosen fit points. Extrapolation is not a forecast probability. Keep on research charts. Exclude from scalping signal quotas and from the count of scanners expected to open trades.

cdnBBG0A.author: WillyAlgoTrader
cdnBBG0A.summary: An ATR-band trend change establishes direction; a touch arms a retest, then reclaim and directional close must qualify within a limited window. Quality combines several factors.
cdnBBG0A.requirements: Wick or ATR stop, R targets and break-even; opposite signals close the existing side. The author’s model gives stop priority. Warmup, retest expiry and the internal active trade intentionally suppress repeats. HTF alignment can be a score contribution rather than a universal hard gate. The enabled ATR-maker variant is deliberate. Local fixtures confirm legacy reversal text closes the wrong side; reader 2 fixes it. Compare as a versioned variant, preserving margin, evidence and execution policy.

qBUHu6aW.author: WillyAlgoTrader

October v1.4 rejects double-sided sweeps, invalidates pending setups when the wick is retaken, and blocks wrong-side stops. The newer publication already has a separate upstream entry on the VM. Keep it separate from the June base. Test cancellation and actual entries; TP1 hit rate does not measure net profitability.

The installed long-label allow-list is an intentional measured reading. A two-sided author-native version needs a separate comparison, not an overwrite. Stop distance percent is distinct from account dollar risk.

RjkDXQnZ.summary: An EMA/ATR trail flips; regime, quality and filters decide the new entry. v1.4 adds context such as nearby obstacles and extension.

H0DfZXtR.summary: Confirmed pivots, candle volume and subsequent reactions build clustered levels. Qualified breakouts or timed retests generate entries.

UWC4kQ9O.author: WillyAlgoTrader

Management alert toggles differ from entry toggles; some target/break-even messages are off by default. Verify every required alert toggle and bind exit/update events to the correct trade. DRgzod5I.author: WillyAlgoTrader

cONRD5q4.author: LuxAlgo

a8ClWGX4.author: LuxAlgo

dLXvYOtT.author: LuxAlgo
dLXvYOtT.summary: Rolling K-means clusters recent closes into channel extrema with dispersion bands. Optional directional denoising and trailing-stop display emphasize the inferred trend; the update addresses missing output on some symbols/timeframes.
dLXvYOtT.requirements: Preserve cluster count, sample window, iteration/history limits and current-price timing. Channel breaks and stop presentation are trend context without explicit trade lifecycle. Denoised boundaries differ from raw centroids used to update the internal direction.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Convergence checks only centroids0,1,2 even when K exceeds three (default five), potentially stopping while upper clusters still move.
findings.action: Compare all configured centroids before accepting convergence.

findings.evidence: Author describes a center based on the average price cluster, but the plotted Average is the arithmetic midpoint of output upper/lower; calculated middle centroid out_avg is unused.
findings.action: Name the midpoint accurately or use the intended middle-cluster output.

V30Sbp5O.author: LuxAlgo
V30Sbp5O.summary: Anchored price/volume profiles display relative traded activity, candle-direction sentiment, developing POC and low-volume liquidity zones. Anchors include fixed, swing and calendar/session choices.
V30Sbp5O.requirements: Treat liquidity and sentiment as historical price/volume proxies, not observed resting orders or aggression. Preserve swing confirmation lag, inclusive anchor membership and latest-bar rebuilding. No entry, stop, target or exit is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Every overlapping bin receives full binWidth/barRange times volume rather than actual overlapWidth/barRange. Partial edge overlaps can overallocate a candle, distorting node and sentiment weights.
findings.action: Use overlap-clamped allocation or disclose the approximation before interpreting relative liquidity.

findings.evidence: Tooltip says Session assumes only regular hours; raw only resets by time(D) and includes every chart bar in the selected range, without a session-hours filter.
findings.action: Do not claim regular-session-only volume when extended-hours chart bars are included.

iOrhpIqc.author: LuxAlgo
iOrhpIqc.summary: Swing-derived support/resistance zones produce delayed breakouts, tests, retests and high-volume wick rejections. Updates add alerts, optional false-breakout distance filtering and changed defaults. Volume annotates breakouts rather than gating them.
iOrhpIqc.requirements: Keep event classes separate: tests hold the zone, retests require prior break state, and rejection requires wick/ATR plus volume criteria. Current/previous zones have independent state. Labels backdate one bar; tests also check current close. No stops, targets or exits are authored.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: MTF mode scales chart-bar pivot length by requested/chart minutes and then detects chart-bar pivots; it never requests actual higher-timeframe OHLC.
findings.action: Describe this as a timeframe-scaled chart lookback; do not substitute aggregated HTF pivot logic without an explicit variant.

findings.evidence: Prior contract says previous high/low is inside the zone. Raw resistance test requires high above bottom with closes below top but allows high above top; support mirror allows low below bottom.
findings.action: Match actual wick-overlap plus close-hold conditions rather than imposing an unprovided opposite-edge bound.

findings.evidence: Most labels/events use bar[1], while tests additionally depend on current close and use once-per-bar-close alerts. Other alerts use default frequency and report current price.
findings.action: Preserve detection time, event-bar time and alert price separately; do not backdate executable entries to labels.

Z8loUcRj.author: LuxAlgo
Z8loUcRj.summary: A price-keyed map accumulates volume or price-weighted volume, selects nearby prices for a profile and highlights its two largest displayed levels. Rounding/steps merge keys; the table update fixes overlapping rows.
Z8loUcRj.requirements: Preserve selected source, historical accumulation window and drawing limits. Profile voids and prominent levels are discretionary context, with no trading lifecycle. Currency weighting uses the rounded source price, not necessarily close.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Author/tooltips show positive Round values reducing decimal precision and negative values rounding integer digits; raw positive values round to powers of ten, while nonpositive values change mintick-based decimal precision.
findings.action: Correct the examples or explicitly retain source rounding semantics.

findings.evidence: The selected sorted-key slice uses idx+szR as exclusive end. This omits the intended farthest upper key and can omit the current key when no higher key exists.
findings.action: Account for center membership and exclusive slice endpoint before asserting symmetric allocation.

findings.evidence: Map values accumulate after the initial historical cutoff and never evict bars that age beyond Amount of bars during live execution.
findings.action: Maintain explicit rolling eviction or label the profile as anchored to its initial loaded cutoff.

58YCiPaa.author: LuxAlgo
58YCiPaa.summary: A randomized RANSAC regression chooses an inlier-rich model, refits selected samples and draws a trend projection, tolerance margin and full-window RMSE channel. Outlier dots are descriptive.
58YCiPaa.requirements: Fit occurs on the last confirmed historical bar, not continuously. Preserve source/window, minimum inliers, tolerance mode and iteration budget; reload randomness can change the result. No trade lifecycle is authored.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Author requires two unique samples; raw makes two independent random index draws without excluding a duplicate, permitting a zero-variance pair.
findings.action: Sample distinct valid indices and handle short history before fitting.

findings.evidence: Final model is refit on accepted points but inlier membership remains the classification from its two-point candidate; labels are not retested against the refitted tolerance.
findings.action: Distinguish selection membership from final-model residuals when evaluating outliers.

kBHEpriQ.author: LuxAlgo
kBHEpriQ.summary: Adaptive MACD changes its second feedback coefficient according to price/time trend strength, retaining longer trends or more cyclic behavior. It displays MACD, EMA signal and histogram without entry markers.
kBHEpriQ.requirements: Preserve fast/slow periods, R-squared lookback, recursive initialization and signal smoothing. Zero-line direction and visually observed divergences provide context; no coded divergence or trade lifecycle is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Description identifies alpha with rolling R-squared on0–1; source uses0.5*R-squared+0.5, restricting coefficient interpolation to0.5–1.
findings.action: Retain or explicitly revise the rescaling rather than claiming the documented full-range interpolation.

3ONrWovL.author: LuxAlgo
3ONrWovL.summary: Volume profiles between confirmed swing events identify relatively low-volume price bins as liquidity levels/voids. Filled bins are deleted or recolored; optional swing labels and a developing last-bar profile add context.
3ONrWovL.requirements: Preserve long pivot confirmation delay and retrospective placement. Fill detection compares prior close with current high/low around the bin midpoint, including gap crossings; it is not full-zone consumption. Present mode limits initial detections, and no entry/exit lifecycle is authored.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Volume allocation uses full bin width for every overlapping candle/bin pair, including partial boundary overlaps.
findings.action: Clamp allocation to actual overlap width before interpreting node significance.

findings.evidence: aVP.vs is filled for a newly confirmed swing profile, then reused without clearing by the last-bar developing profile, whose range and bin spacing can differ.
findings.action: Use a fresh accumulator for developing bins when a pivot confirms on the last bar.

y2WjAnHA.author: LuxAlgo
y2WjAnHA.summary: Three clusters of price-minus-SuperTrend distances produce bullish, consensus and bearish oscillator outputs. Consensus sign suggests trend; all clusters on the same side of zero indicate stronger alignment, while disagreement contextualizes retracement.
y2WjAnHA.requirements: Preserve factor range/step, ATR recurrence, clustering budget/history and output smoothing. Strong circles mark regime values, not entry events. Missing clusters retain prior smoothed outputs, so values need validity handling. No stop, target or exit is authored.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Empty cluster averages become na; each smoothed output adds nz(centroid-output), which retains its old value rather than indicating missing current evidence.
findings.action: Track cluster validity separately so stale held outputs are not represented as a current three-cluster consensus.

wP7WWjLL.author: LuxAlgo
wP7WWjLL.summary: Multiple SuperTrend factors receive smoothed directional-price-change scores; three performance clusters select an average factor for an adaptive SuperTrend. Flip labels show a scaled score and an adaptive stop average adds context.
wP7WWjLL.requirements: Preserve configured cluster, factor grid, performance memory and closed-bar observation. Label direction comes from trend transition/style, not its numeric text. Scores are historical performance proxies, not success probabilities. Stop use is described, but compulsory opposite-position reversal and targets are not specified.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior contract says opposite labels close and reverse; source only changes trend and draws labels/stop, while author discusses SuperTrend-style interpretation without an executable reversal rule.
findings.action: Keep trend flips as signals until a strategy explicitly defines position closure/reversal and fill timing.

findings.evidence: Empty selected cluster retains the previous target factor while its performance average becomes zero; the resulting line may use a stale factor without a current selected cluster.
findings.action: Expose cluster validity and stale-factor fallback rather than treating every output as a fresh optimization.

aRxQ1g82.author: LuxAlgo
aRxQ1g82.summary: Weighted QQE smooths a direction-weighted RSI and trails it with oscillator-volatility bands, making reversal crossings harder as weight rises. Overbought/oversold and visual divergence are contextual interpretations.
aRxQ1g82.requirements: Preserve weighting by previous RSI/stop relationship, RMA/EMA sequence and ratcheting oscillator stop. The trailing line is in oscillator units, not an executable price stop. No required entry, target or exit is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

yRHQ9ufY.author: LuxAlgo
yRHQ9ufY.summary: A close-price anchor resets after a sufficiently large ATR-scaled deviation. Its direction selects support zones in uptrends or resistance zones in downtrends, with optional extension of recent zones.
yRHQ9ufY.requirements: Preserve reset threshold, held ATR width and direction; meaningful boundary breaks suggest reversal but are not prescribed trades. Historical extensions are context, with no entry or position lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Last-bar extension iterates Extend Last and directly indexes records without limiting to available records; short/flat histories can supply fewer records.
findings.action: Bound the extension loop by records.size() before drawing.

findings.evidence: Factor permits zero but zone widths divide hold_atr by that factor, yielding undefined widths.
findings.action: Validate a positive factor before using these zones.

J9LyN92e.author: LuxAlgo
J9LyN92e.summary: A lower swing high and higher swing low form contraction bounds; a boundary break creates a minor pattern and midpoint expansion line. Breaking both sides upgrades the latest pattern to major; confirmed liquidity pivots suggest discretionary targets/stops.
J9LyN92e.requirements: Keep pivot confirmation, retrospective placement and later major/minor reclassification separate from availability time. Expansion/liquidity lines have no fixed target allocation or stop execution rule, and no mandatory entries are supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Break detection reads high[length]/low[length], not current high/low, and draws at n-length. Thus the pattern break itself is delayed by the contraction lookback, beyond merely describing pivot lag.
findings.action: Timestamp detection on the current bar and do not execute from its historical box endpoint.

Bcufg8oX.author: LuxAlgo
Bcufg8oX.summary: HyperTrend estimates a causal linear trend using ATR-limited price deviations and directional drift, with adjustable channel width. Wick contacts and repeated midpoint tests are discretionary support/resistance interpretations.
Bcufg8oX.requirements: Preserve midpoint reanchoring rather than a direct close reset, ATR200 warmup, direction-change-held width and slope scaling. Live values can change intrabar; no trade entry, stop, target or exit is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Factor and Slope both accept zero and are divisors in the drift branch.
findings.action: Require positive denominators before treating the channel as available context.

oZ5v4fFM.author: LuxAlgo
oZ5v4fFM.summary: A regression fitted to the completed previous time interval is extrapolated into the next. Dashboard percentages measure persistence of successive slope signs separately for prior uptrends and downtrends.
oZ5v4fFM.requirements: Preserve interval-boundary fitting before collecting the new bar and distinguish trend-sign persistence from forecast accuracy or profitability. Lines and candle colors are contextual; no trading lifecycle is authored.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Fit only checks that the preceding interval has at least one sample; one-point intervals produce zero x variance and undefined slope.
findings.action: Require at least two distinct bar indices and report unavailable estimates for shorter intervals.

rRKtzvFt.author: LuxAlgo
rRKtzvFt.summary: ATR-filtered three-candle price gaps are divided into stacked liquidity-void boxes, with optional retained filled regions. The author recommends combining them with market structure and supply/demand context.
rRKtzvFt.requirements: Preserve ATR144 threshold, middle-candle close confirmation and consecutive-gap extension rules. Detection uses price geometry, not measured low trading volume. Boxes are contextual and supply no entry, stop, target or exit.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Source marks each of thirteen slices filled on any strict high/low overlap. A filled slice does not mean price returned to the full gap origin described in the prose.
findings.action: Distinguish partial slice visitation from complete void fill; do not infer a target execution from a color change.

fq4wSUev.author: LuxAlgo
fq4wSUev.summary: New York Silver Bullet windows identify retested FVG setups and session-end liquidity reference targets. Modes add trend alignment, close-location and permanent invalidation restrictions; previous-any versus previous-similar sessions select candidate swings.
fq4wSUev.requirements: Use America/New_York with daylight saving, confirmed right1 pivots and authored sub15-minute guidance. FVGs are hidden retrospectively when invalid/unretested. Minimum trade framework is a target-distance screen, explicitly not entry-to-exit range. No executable entry/stop/target-allocation lifecycle is provided.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: EndSB becomes true on the first outside-session bar, but strict/super-strict validation reads that bar current close rather than the final in-session close.
findings.action: Use the actual session-ending close for an authored session-end implementation, or label source-compatible first-outside-bar timing.

findings.evidence: Author describes bearish threshold from highest FVG bottom minus framework; source uses box top minus framework.
findings.action: Resolve the upper-edge versus lower-edge target screen before using these candidate levels.

findings.evidence: Author says nonforex/futures/index symbols screen targets against session high/low; raw strict modes still use FVG bounds, with framework distance merely set to zero.
findings.action: Apply the documented asset fallback explicitly if implementing target eligibility; current drawings alone are not runtime approval.

lIdNGLiV.author: LuxAlgo
lIdNGLiV.summary: Predictive Ranges steps a central estimate by an ATR-scaled distance when source deviates sufficiently, retaining half/full-width support and resistance bands between steps. Central-level changes contextualize trend.
lIdNGLiV.requirements: Preserve source scale, timeframe and held-width logic; author describes possible reversals at levels without mandatory entries or lifecycle. Selected higher-timeframe output must be treated separately from chart-timeframe completed-bar values.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Author/prior contract broadly call output nonrepainting, but request.security uses unshifted live selected-timeframe inputs. Higher-timeframe levels can change before that timeframe closes.
findings.action: Require confirmed selected-timeframe values for stable historical/live parity; default lookahead-off alone does not provide confirmation.

asr7nOb2.author: LuxAlgo
asr7nOb2.summary: Period-anchored profiles display traded-volume nodes and candle-direction sentiment, with an optional developing POC. Multiple significant zones may occur inside one profile; object limits constrain historical display.
asr7nOb2.requirements: Preserve anchor selection, thresholds and latest-bar rebuilding. Sentiment is a candle-polarity allocation proxy, not actual aggressor orders. Profile colors, POC and zones are contextual without a position lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Both completed/developing profile loops allocate a full bin-width fraction to any candle overlap rather than actual partial overlap.
findings.action: Clamp each candle/bin allocation before interpreting node significance.

findings.evidence: Developing high/low use rpLN bars, while its volume loop includes rpLN through0, totaling rpLN+1 bars. The first anchored bar can contribute volume outside the computed price range.
findings.action: Use identical bar membership for range and allocation.

findings.evidence: Session tooltip claims regular-hours-only data, but reset logic and profile loops include chart bars without a regular-session filter.
findings.action: Retain actual chart-session coverage explicitly.

rc0kPSGU.author: LuxAlgo
rc0kPSGU.summary: Previous-day intrabar high/low volume bins define supply and demand areas and averages, extended as discretionary support/resistance. Breaks and pullbacks suggest trend context without prescribed trades.
rc0kPSGU.requirements: Use exchange-calendar day transitions, sufficient LTF data and prior-day availability time despite backward box placement. No entries, stops, targets or exits are authored.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: New-day reset initializes csum to current volume, then the next bar adds that same first-bar volume again. Meanwhile the bin loop excludes the first bar at j=n-x1. Denominator and allocated sample set therefore disagree.
findings.action: Build a consistent prior-day sample set and count its first bar exactly once in both denominator and bins.

findings.evidence: High/low bin tests use strict inequalities on both sides, omitting values exactly on bin boundaries.
findings.action: Assign each boundary to one bin before treating area thresholds as complete daily-volume coverage.

ZpHqSrBK.author: LuxAlgo
ZpHqSrBK.summary: Monotonic fractal highs/lows create structure references; close crossovers produce CHoCH on direction reversal or BOS continuation. Optional intervening-extreme levels stop extending after close breaks and mark circles.
ZpHqSrBK.requirements: Preserve half-length fractal confirmation delay, one-cross-per-fractal state and strict monotonic pattern. Structure/fractal percentages measure usage, not win rates. Support/resistance circles are level breaks; the author defines no mandatory trading lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: CHoCH/BOS labels are placed halfway between the confirmed fractal location and current break bar, rather than on the bar when the break becomes known.
findings.action: Use current detection time for any downstream event and retain historical label position only for display.

qTWl7ZOy.author: LuxAlgo
qTWl7ZOy.summary: Countertrend setups combine momentum counts, exhaustion counts and a subsequent price flip. The author distinguishes momentum, exhaustion and qualified modes, with separate support/resistance, risk and target levels.
qTWl7ZOy.requirements: Require the chosen mode and its completed phase before the opposite price flip; default None disables L/S entries. Counts, perfection marks and risk warnings alone are not entries. Momentum counts require an uninterrupted sequence; exhaustion is nonconsecutive and has a special thirteenth-count qualification. Preserve the source delay, equality and wick-comparison differences explicitly. Risk/target annotations and discretionary warnings do not implement order exits or automatic reversal.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; prior hash-pinned contract plus raw calculations, signal, timing and lifecycle sections inspected. Not independent full-source audit or runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Author describes close versus close two bars earlier; raw bCC compares close <= low[2] and sCC compares close >= high[2].
findings.action: Retain the actual wick-based source variant; do not silently substitute the prose close comparison.

findings.evidence: The exhaustion entry arm uses C.sCC[5] == 13 and C.bCC[5] == 13 before its price flip; prose describes completion then flip without specifying this five-bar delay.
findings.action: Model the source delay explicitly and validate any prose-based variant separately.

findings.evidence: Momentum uses close < close[4] for the bullish countdown and an unconditional else for the bearish countdown, so equality increments bearish momentum despite prose requiring a higher close.
findings.action: Preserve the inequality/equality distinction in the source contract.

findings.evidence: L/S labels and alert text carry selected risk and target values, but warning-state booleans do not execute target/stop exits; risky/void risk falls back to signal high/low and default alerts are not close-only.
findings.action: Require a separately specified execution lifecycle; do not promote warnings to exits or reversals.

findings.evidence: Risk alerts combine bullCross OR bearCross AND enabled without parentheses; momentum-completion alerts use exhaustion cmpltd rather than Bcmpltd. Disabled settings therefore do not consistently suppress corresponding alerts.
findings.action: Keep these alert-gating discrepancies visible; a reader must not assume every raw alert follows the displayed feature toggle.

xGnUhodO.author: LuxAlgo
xGnUhodO.summary: A six-series circular dashboard compares percentage changes in open interest, using custom symbols or COT report presets. It offers signed shapes around a middle ring or outward magnitude shapes, with color and a symbol table.
xGnUhodO.requirements: Treat each series as external-data context, not directional entry, stop or target. Preserve each requested timeframe and invalid-symbol/NA state; COT publication cadence is weekly even when daily requests are selected. The display is recalculated around the last chart bar and has replay/visibility limitations. Zero, missing and signed values must remain distinguishable.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; prior hash-pinned contract plus raw calculations, signal, timing and lifecycle sections inspected. Not independent full-source audit or runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The display scale m is ceil(max absolute six changes); when every change is zero or NA converted through nz, m is zero and shape coordinates divide by m.
findings.action: Guard a zero scale in any port and preserve NA separately from true zero.

findings.evidence: Requests use request.security with no confirmed-period offset, so a custom symbol on an unfinished higher timeframe may change intrabar; missing values are retained for labels but nz-converted for shapes.
findings.action: Do not label the external dashboard universally confirmed or use its geometry as a historical signal.

5FCWOMoR.author: LuxAlgo
5FCWOMoR.summary: Ranks support/resistance candidates from moving averages, Bollinger bands, previous highs/lows, Fibonacci pivots and chart-timeframe swings by historical breaks. Line and value modes change which historical level is tested.
5FCWOMoR.requirements: Use the fixed lookback, selected source/timeframe and fade setting. Value mode follows changing series and limits previous-high/low and Fibonacci tests to the current higher-timeframe interval; line mode tests the current level through the lookback. Swings ignore the selected higher timeframe. Preserve delayed pivot confirmation and prior-period security values. Rank labels and faded levels provide context without authored entries, stops, targets or exits.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; prior hash-pinned contract plus raw calculations, signal, timing and lifecycle sections inspected. Not independent full-source audit or runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prose describes ranks from 1 through 10, but source labels indexof(grade)+1 after sorting unique grades. The number of ranks depends on fade and available distinct grades, with no ten-rank cap.
findings.action: Describe these as relative unique-grade ranks rather than a guaranteed normalized 1–10 scale.

findings.evidence: Prose says only unbroken swings remain; the arrays discard a swing only when a newly confirmed pivot reaches or exceeds it, rather than on every price breach.
findings.action: Preserve the pivot-confirmation lag and do not assume displayed swing levels are currently unbreached.

Ai8Heos2.author: LuxAlgo
Ai8Heos2.summary: Builds volume profiles between confirmed swings and a developing profile, showing POC, value area, low-volume liquidity regions and optional extension of prior POCs until a cross or touch.
Ai8Heos2.requirements: Confirm pivots after the configured right-side length before exposing historical profiles. Preserve the chosen value-area fraction, developing-profile updates and POC extension mode. Cross/touch alerts are level notifications without long/short instructions or an execution lifecycle. Low-volume regions describe a bar-volume approximation, not observed order-book liquidity. Retain source-specific close-cross alerts and current-bar timing.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; prior hash-pinned contract plus raw calculations, signal, timing and lifecycle sections inspected. Not independent full-source audit or runtime approval.

findings.evidence: For every intersecting price bin, volume is weighted by full bin width divided by candle range rather than actual overlap; partial edge bins can overallocate volume.
findings.action: If ported, document the approximation or separately validate an overlap-weighted correction.

findings.evidence: aVP.vs is initialized once per bar, populated for the completed swing, then reused without clearing for the developing profile on a last-bar pivot confirmation, despite different price-bin boundaries.
findings.action: Reset or separate the developing accumulator in a validated port.

findings.evidence: Alert text says touches/crosses, but all three conditions are ta.cross(close, evolving level); wick-only touches do not qualify, and changing levels can cause the crossing.
findings.action: Expose close-cross semantics and distinguish from POC-extension wick-touch logic.

hQc9VrGn.author: LuxAlgo
hQc9VrGn.summary: Visible-range support/resistance classification ranks higher-timeframe averages, Bollinger bands, previous extremes, Fibonacci levels and chart-timeframe swings. Panning or zooming recomputes the display.
hQc9VrGn.requirements: Require the actual visible interval and selected line/value mode; this is chart-dependent reference context, not a rolling historical trade signal. Preserve prior-period higher-timeframe values and delayed chart-timeframe swings. Value mode changes historical tests, while swing tests remain horizontal. Fade controls break-based opacity. No entry, stop, target or exit is authored.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The break loops run last_bar_index - sBix bars backward from the right visible bar. If the chart is scrolled into history, this exceeds the visible width and counts bars before the left visible edge.
findings.action: Use rightVisibleIndex-leftVisibleIndex for a faithful visible-only implementation; retain this source discrepancy.

findings.evidence: Ranks are indexof(grade)+1 over sorted unique grades, not normalized to 1–10; default fade also limits the distinct grade count.
findings.action: Describe relative ranks and avoid treating ten as a fixed maximum.

findings.evidence: At the left visible bar lowest and the initial low-pivot entry are both initialized from high, so a uniquely lowest wick on that first bar is excluded.
findings.action: Initialize the low boundary from low in a separately validated correction.

findings.evidence: Swing arrays discard old levels only when newly confirmed pivots exceed them, leaving potentially breached levels until pivot confirmation.
findings.action: Do not treat every displayed swing as an unbroken live level.

Qk4vBbfL.author: LuxAlgo
Qk4vBbfL.summary: Clusters nearby swing highs/lows into buyside/sellside liquidity levels; breaches begin zones intended to distinguish possible reversals from continuation. Optional large price gaps are displayed as liquidity voids.
Qk4vBbfL.requirements: Require at least three clustered pivots inside the ATR-based margin, with one right-side confirmation bar. Detection/update and breach notifications describe levels, not long/short entries. A breached zone may suggest reversal or continuation but neither has an authored execution rule, stop, target or exit. Preserve present/history scope, zone margins, strict wick breaches and optional gap visualization; these are price-derived liquidity proxies.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Pivot and breach branches have no barstate.isconfirmed guard, and alert calls use their default frequency. Current high/low can breach a level before close despite prior knownAtClose classification.
findings.action: Preserve intrabar provisional timing or explicitly define a close-confirmed adapter.

findings.evidence: Detection/update alerts appear only in the new-level else branches; updating an existing same-start level changes its box without alerting.
findings.action: Do not promise an alert for every existing-level update.

pkxnfdYZ.author: LuxAlgo
pkxnfdYZ.summary: An anchored regression channel contains a sloped volume profile, line of control, developing LOC and value area. The user chooses both endpoint times; large ranges may exhaust drawing or runtime limits.
pkxnfdYZ.requirements: Require explicit left and right anchors aligned to available bars, with right later than left. The final channel fits the full selected interval, so a developing LOC within it is retrospective under that final fit. LOC and value-area lines are possible support/resistance references without executable entries or exits. Preserve sections, width, value-area fraction and updated developing-LOC color.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Each intersected section receives the candle entire volume instead of a fractional allocation; the total profile volume can exceed traded volume and wider candles influence more sections.
findings.action: Describe section-touch volume weighting, or validate a volume-conserving alternative separately.

findings.evidence: The value-area loop adds both adjacent sections before checking the target fraction, even if LOC alone already meets it; 0% therefore still expands.
findings.action: Check the current included fraction before expansion in a validated port.

findings.evidence: The regression slope and encompassing width use all data through userX2, then recompute developing LOC back through that fixed final channel.
findings.action: Do not expose backdrawn developing LOC as information available at its historical timestamp.

aLTywnJ0.author: LuxAlgo
aLTywnJ0.summary: Marks eight configurable ICT time windows, tracks their price ranges and classifies completed windows as accumulation, manipulation or expansion using surrounding swing structure. Advance alerts announce upcoming windows.
aLTywnJ0.requirements: Use the supported 1-, 3- or 5-minute chart context and one-minute data with explicit manual DST switches. Classifications are finalized after the window; no class or advance notice is an entry or exit. Preserve wick/body swing selection, pivot lag, range/midpoint extensions and all classification exceptions. Time notices, liquidity interpretations and drawn levels lack a trading lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Two-sided sweeps can classify as Expansion when open/close traverse opposite quartiles; one-sided sweeps can classify as Accumulation, unlike the simplified prose classification.
findings.action: Keep the full source decision tree rather than mapping sweep counts directly to labels.

findings.evidence: At macro start the source takes only ltfB[idx], then uses chart high/low on later bars. Remaining minutes of the starting higher-timeframe bar are omitted; the terminal minute is included.
findings.action: Do not guarantee identical macro extrema across 1-, 3- and 5-minute charts without boundary-minute validation.

findings.evidence: The alert executes before the _alert guard; that toggle gates only the vertical line, so disabling it does not disable the scheduled alert call.
findings.action: Document the source toggle behavior and gate alerts explicitly if implementing the advertised toggle.

findings.evidence: The prior idea says first lower-timeframe candle only, but subsequent branches update range highs/lows throughout the macro and at its terminal bar.
findings.action: Correct the prior summary to a developing window range with the noted boundary limitations.

eRTyjm9j.author: LuxAlgo
eRTyjm9j.summary: EquiVolume redraws candles or volume columns with widths scaled by volume. Optional lower-timeframe candle signs estimate the directional share of each displayed candle.
eRTyjm9j.requirements: Treat this as a remapped chart, not time-aligned entry markers. Preserve the requested chart/volume mode, effective automatically adjusted lower timeframe, directional volume versus bar-count method and unavailable intrabar data. Visible-chart changes alter the reconstruction. No entry, stop, target or exit is provided.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Width equals round(normalizedVolume*maxW)+minW, so the largest candle has maxW+minW width instead of the advertised maximum.
findings.action: Treat maxW as added span in the source variant, or validate a maxW-minW normalization.

findings.evidence: Bar-count fill divides by up+down counts, excluding doji intrabars, rather than all lower-timeframe candles in the example.
