findings.action: Do not describe the underlying dataset as exactly all visible candles; retain the shifted display mapping.

5ERKwGoq.author: LuxAlgo
5ERKwGoq.summary: Highlights the first fair-value gap per daily session, its midpoint and session range, with formation, mitigation, inside-gap and midpoint-cross notifications. Mitigated gaps remain visible as inverse-gap context.
5ERKwGoq.requirements: Use intraday charts and the source daily-boundary session definition. Only the first qualifying gap of either direction is selected per session; a bullish gap requires low above high two bars back and the intervening close above that high, with bearish symmetry. Mitigation uses a strict close through the far edge. Inside notifications are states, not first-touch events. Neither direction nor alerts define trades, stops or exits.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: After resetting isnew at the daily boundary, the same bar may qualify using the prior two session bars. The selected first gap need not consist solely of candles within the new session.
findings.action: Preserve the cross-session source behavior rather than imposing an unrecorded three-candle session gate.

findings.evidence: At a new day only isnew resets; old top/bottom and mitigated remain. The mitigation branch lacks an isnew guard and can emit a stale prior-session mitigation before any new gap exists.
findings.action: Gate mitigation to the current session gap in a validated correction; do not classify stale notices as new-session events.

findings.evidence: All formation/inside/mitigation/cross alertconditions can evaluate on the open bar; no confirmation guard is coded.
findings.action: Specify alert timing explicitly and keep these context alerts outside entry routing.

y4plLaDG.author: LuxAlgo
y4plLaDG.summary: A rolling time-by-price grid displays volume activity, each column POC and the strongest overall cell. The author explicitly warns of repainting and backpainting.
y4plLaDG.requirements: Use lookback, row and column settings as chart-context parameters. The grid is recomputed on the last bar against the full rolling high/low range; historical cells and POCs cannot be treated as events known at their displayed positions. Activity is a bar-volume estimate, not measured liquidity or a directional trade signal. No execution lifecycle is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Every row touched by a candle receives its entire volume; a wide candle contributes its full volume repeatedly across the matrix.
findings.action: Document touch-weighted volume rather than volume conserved across price bins.

findings.evidence: Lookback accepts 1 although column indexing divides by length-1, and row indexing divides by upper-lower without a flat-range guard.
findings.action: Reject or handle single-bar and zero-price-range grids in any port.

1owp3WD0.author: LuxAlgo
1owp3WD0.summary: Breaker formation establishes a setup; only subsequent retest rejection signals are potential entries. The author proposes opposing premium/discount arrays as targets and midpoint closes as invalidation, with optional block-height targets.
1owp3WD0.requirements: Long requires a valid bullish block, open strictly between midpoint and top, then close above top; short mirrors below midpoint. Formation arrows and R rearm marks are not entries. Respect center-break suppression and optional rearming, body/two-candle construction, PD filter, new-pattern reset and pivot lag. The suggested 5–10-bar proximity is a preference, not a coded cutoff. Optional TP lines use block height; cancellation and mitigation need an explicit execution policy.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Author explicitly limits entries to retests. Prior contract promotes +BB/-BB setup alerts to entries; raw formation alerts and large arrows are distinct from signal UP/DN and reset R.
findings.action: Remove formation and reset markers from entry routing; match only retest signal UP/DN with the full state conditions.

findings.evidence: Prose says open within the block, but raw long open must be above midpoint and below top, with mirrored short open below midpoint and above bottom.
findings.action: Keep the stricter source half-block requirement.

findings.evidence: Optional TP checks require open below/high above the long target (short mirrored), precede new retest arming, and do not place orders. Repeated retests reset target-hit flags; reset R arms scalp tracking without a retest entry.
findings.action: Do not infer generic wick-touch fills, entry-bar targets, pyramiding or position exits from these plotting states; specify and test the intended lifecycle.

findings.evidence: Direct retest/cancel/mitigation alert() calls request bar-close frequency, while parallel alertcondition calls have no confirmation guard; TP direct alerts use once-per-bar frequency.
findings.action: Keep channel-specific timing and reject generic glyph-only matching of formation and retest arrows.

5UuBjDYO.author: LuxAlgo
5UuBjDYO.summary: A rolling range profile accumulates signed close-to-open changes in price rows and highlights the strongest positive and negative rows. Optional intrabar analysis uses smaller candle bodies wholly contained within rows.
5UuBjDYO.requirements: Use the recent-bar range, row count, width and selected intrabar timeframe. Standard mode adds a whole candle body change to every intersected row; intrabar mode requires the entire smaller body inside one row. Percentages retain the chart-bar absolute-body denominator. Neutral or strong bins are possible support/resistance references without entry or exit rules. The last-bar profile is redrawn and may change intrabar.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior contract says lower-timeframe data is used only when enabled; raw request.security_lower_tf executes unconditionally before the useIb branch.
findings.action: Validate the selected lower timeframe even when intrabar calculations are disabled.

findings.evidence: The bin width divides by maximum absolute signed row total, and labels divide by sum of chart absolute bodies, without zero guards; empty intrabar arrays are indexed through an unguarded 0..size-1 loop.
findings.action: Handle missing intrabars, fully neutral rows and all-doji windows explicitly in any port.

uvW8BtQj.author: LuxAlgo
uvW8BtQj.summary: Forecasts periodic volume from medians and quartiles of corresponding ordinal bars in prior daily intervals, with manual or automatic forward window length. Historical median and quartile plots are supplied for comparison.
uvW8BtQj.requirements: Require usable volume and enough comparable daily intervals. Align by bar position within each day, not a guaranteed wall-clock time. Preserve memory length, forward-window wrapping and missing or unequal-length session behavior. Forecast and quartile lines are volume context, not directional signals or an execution lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The current volume is unshifted into its ordinal-slot sample before q25/q50/q75 are calculated, so the plotted historical forecast already includes the actual volume it is compared against.
findings.action: Label this as an updated contemporaneous estimate; calculate from prior samples only for a genuine out-of-sample historical forecast.

findings.evidence: The forward loop gets array_2d[fcast_bar] without a size guard; early incomplete daily history can leave requested future ordinal slots unavailable.
findings.action: Require enough populated slots or stop the forecast gracefully; do not invent missing seasonal observations.

c4Z9xThG.author: LuxAlgo
c4Z9xThG.summary: A market-structure trailing stop resets on CHoCH alone or all CHoCH/BOS events, then ratchets by a chosen percentage of new closing-price extremes. Structure lines identify the corresponding breaks.
c4Z9xThG.requirements: Confirm symmetric pivots before close breaks of their levels. On bullish reset use the lowest low since the broken high pivot; on bearish reset use the highest high since the broken low pivot. Trail using increments of running close extremes and the selected factor. This supplies an optional stop for an independently chosen entry strategy; a stop breach changes fill color without an authored exit event or reversal entry.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The source plots a trailing stop and only recolors the area when price passes it; there are no entry or exit alerts/orders, consistent with author presenting it as an additional exit tool for another strategy.
findings.action: Keep as a stop overlay; any executable breach exit and entry method require separate specifications.

findings.evidence: Pivot lag is length bars, but close-break calculations themselves lack a confirmed-bar gate and can vary before the current bar closes.
findings.action: Use an explicit close-confirmation policy if consuming the stop or structure breaks.

UpWXXsbC.author: LuxAlgo
UpWXXsbC.summary: Volume-threshold zones are accumulated inward from the visible range extremes using intrabar highs and lows, with ordinary and weighted averages and equilibrium references. The author presents them as descriptive support/resistance.
UpWXXsbC.requirements: Require the exact visible interval, resolution, threshold and intrabar timeframe. Recalculate on chart-range changes and respect intrabar-history/runtime limits. High/low-location volume is a proxy for supply and demand, not order-book liquidity. Zone tests and possible reversal language do not provide executable entries, stops, targets or exits.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Total volume includes the left visible bar but the bin loop excludes it. Strict high/low inequalities also discard values exactly on bin edges, including outer extrema.
findings.action: Align numerator/denominator windows and define inclusive edge assignment in a validated implementation.

findings.evidence: The page says equal or exceed the threshold, while source requires a strict greater-than percentage.
findings.action: Preserve the strict source threshold or validate an explicit inclusive variant.

findings.evidence: The ordinary equilibrium line is midpoint(max,min), not the average of the supply and demand zone averages described by the author; unequal zone widths make these differ.
findings.action: Keep the range midpoint distinct from the midpoint of zone-average levels.

ib4uqBJx.author: LuxAlgo
ib4uqBJx.summary: An ICT analysis toolkit draws market structure, order/breaker blocks, liquidity clusters, displacements, several imbalances, opening gaps, Fibonacci references and killzones. Author trade examples are discretionary combinations, explicitly including hindsight examples.
ib4uqBJx.requirements: Keep these components as context: sweep, structure shift and imbalance retest are separate conditions, not interchangeable entries. Preserve independent feature toggles, present/history limits, swing confirmation, wick/body construction, mitigation rules and session timezones. IFVG means implied FVG here. No unified entry, stop, target or exit lifecycle is encoded; example liquidity stops and OB/BPR/gap targets are contextual suggestions.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Author describes implied-gap boundaries as wick/body averages, but raw IFVG boxes use adjacent high/low overlap endpoints directly. Both FVG modes also require the middle candle to pass a large-body/short-wick displacement filter.
findings.action: Keep source geometry/filtering distinct from a generic FVG or wick-midpoint implied-gap implementation.

findings.evidence: MSS/BOS labels are centered on historical structure lines, polarity arrows are backdated to swing bars, and open-bar close/wick conditions are unconfirmed. Prior contract nonrepainting/last-bar-only wording is too broad.
findings.action: Preserve event detection time separately from drawing position; displacement and structure labels remain context.

findings.evidence: Present mode gates liquidity/FVG/order-block detection, but volume imbalance and market-structure detection do not use the 500-bar per gate; structure instead deletes prior trend drawings.
findings.action: Describe per-feature history behavior rather than a universal last-500-bars computation window.

5KfHPCbL.author: LuxAlgo
5KfHPCbL.summary: Displays retained new-week or new-day opening-gap zones and intermediate Event Horizon PD Array levels as potential support/resistance references.
5KfHPCbL.requirements: Form a gap from the new period open and previous chart-bar close, retain the configured amount, and sort gaps by their average price before constructing neighboring intermediate levels. These references do not constitute guaranteed price barriers or an entry/exit strategy. No stops or targets are mandated.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The prior contract describes midpoints between sorted gap averages, but raw EHPDA averages the top of the lower-average gap and bottom of the next higher-average gap.
findings.action: Correct the formula description to facing gap edges after sorting by average.

findings.evidence: EHPDA calculation requires more than two retained gaps, so exactly two neighboring gaps never generate their intermediate level, including Amount=2.
findings.action: Expose the three-gap prerequisite or validate an inclusive two-gap correction.

M3V8NCvv.author: LuxAlgo
M3V8NCvv.summary: Averages daily price changes by month/day across the chosen years, optionally cumulates the seasonal indexes and fits a regression line. The author recommends daily charts and cautions that stable market seasonality is uncertain.
M3V8NCvv.requirements: Use daily open-to-close absolute or percent changes, preserving the selected lookback, cumulative mode and regression. Missing calendar days are treated as zero in the display. This is a calendar summary positioned on a chart, not a future price forecast or a seasonal entry strategy. Lower-timeframe history coverage and unfinished daily observations require explicit treatment.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Daily request.security uses default merging, but storage triggers on the first chart bar of each new day; historical intraday bars can therefore store the previous completed daily change under the new day, while realtime sees a developing day.
findings.action: Prefer the authored daily-chart use; pair explicitly confirmed daily data with its own date before supporting intraday calculations.

findings.evidence: The prior idea calls the curve a year-ahead forecast. Source draws calendar indexes across the last 366 chart-bar positions and does not predict or date future prices.
findings.action: Label it a seasonal calendar profile, with cumulative arithmetic changes rather than compounded investment returns.

piIbWMpY.author: LuxAlgo
piIbWMpY.summary: Creates order blocks after swing breaks, converts them into breaker blocks after body penetration and optionally backpaints historical polarity arrows. The author explicitly distinguishes historical labels from usable current zones.
piIbWMpY.requirements: Respect swing lookback, candle-body versus full-range boundaries and retained bullish/bearish counts. Bullish blocks become breakers when min(open,close) is below their bottom; bearish blocks use max(open,close) above their top. Later opposite-edge closes remove breakers. Polarity arrows describe a prior swing inside a breaker and are not current entry signals. Retest opportunities remain discretionary, with no encoded order lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior description says close-through mitigation, while source tests min(close,open) or max(close,open); a gapped open beyond the edge can qualify despite a close back inside.
findings.action: Preserve body-extreme mitigation and separate it from a close-only variant.

findings.evidence: Display loops end at min(showCount-1,array.size()) inclusively. When available blocks are fewer than requested, they attempt array.get(size), including zero-size arrays.
findings.action: Guard nonempty arrays and use size-1 for the inclusive endpoint in a validated port.

findings.evidence: Optional polarity arrows are drawn at top.x/btm.x rather than the current detection bar, exactly as the author warns.
findings.action: Exclude these arrows from current-bar entry detection and preserve both detection and anchor times.

KvrhsPTp.author: LuxAlgo
KvrhsPTp.summary: Three configurable zigzags recognize five-wave impulses, ABC corrections and possible subsequent motive-wave starts, with retracement lines and invalidation styling. The author explicitly shows later wave extension and invalidation.
KvrhsPTp.requirements: Retain one-bar pivot confirmation, per-zigzag state and separate completion, correction, possible-start and invalidation events. Possible-start alerts require a post-ABC pivot beyond wave five and are once per tracked wave; they are directional observations, not an authored complete trade rule. Correction direction is opposite the preceding motive wave. Dotted impulses, dashed corrections, box breaches and Fibonacci levels are not automatically stops or exits.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Author lists pattern-event alerts without a mandatory entry rule. Prior contract calls possible-start alerts entries; motive completion, correction and invalidation remain context, including the known misleading Bullish text in the bearish correction invalidation branch.
findings.action: Treat possible-start as a candidate event requiring an explicit strategy; never route completion/invalidation by a Bullish/Bearish word alone.

findings.evidence: The low source expression tests i_hi == close instead of i_lo == close. Selecting low=close can therefore return min(open,close), depending on the high selector.
findings.action: Use the actual selector behavior in parity work and validate correction to i_lo separately.

findings.evidence: Wave-five lines/labels are moved on extensions; invalidation changes earlier drawings. Alerts use bar-close frequency but the drawing history is mutable and possible-start circles are placed on the prior pivot bar.
findings.action: Do not call the chart nonrepainting; retain detection time and the emitted event independently from later drawing updates.

AkpEZFyO.author: LuxAlgo
AkpEZFyO.summary: The Strat toolkit numbers candles, searches user combos, records delayed pivot combos and detects pivot-machine-gun breaks of successive lower highs or higher lows. It also provides counts and a multi-timeframe dashboard.
AkpEZFyO.requirements: Preserve strict bar classifications, custom combo order, PMG sequence length and minimum broken levels. Pivot combos are retrospective and the higher-timeframe dashboard can remain provisional. Candle numbers and PMGs are observations for a separately chosen Strat approach; the author does not provide stops, targets or a mandatory entry/exit rule. Respect the difference between visible PMG labels and raw PMG alerts.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: PMG labels and lines require breaks >= minBreak, but alertconditions only require a nonzero bull_pmg/bear_pmg; one broken level can alert under the default minimum of three.

findings.evidence: Equal-extreme and nonoverlapping-gap candles can have all number flags zero, yet custom and pivot combo builders default any unclassified bar to 3.
findings.action: Keep unclassified cases distinct rather than silently counting them as outside bars.

findings.evidence: Prior contract marks PMG observations as entries; the author describes detection and possible continuation behavior without a trade execution rule. PMG computation also stops if both display options are disabled.
findings.action: Retain PMG as a conditional pattern event requiring an independently specified lifecycle, not universal buy/sell authorization.

1KtO6NVA.author: LuxAlgo
1KtO6NVA.summary: Detects three-candle implied fair-value gaps from a dominant middle body and adjacent shadows, with gap boxes, midpoint references and formation alerts. The author suggests their use as support/resistance or fill areas.
1KtO6NVA.requirements: Require the dominant middle body, both shadow thresholds and correctly ordered shadow-midpoint boundaries. Preserve the raw overlap condition and threshold denominator differences from prose. IFVG denotes implied, not inverse, gaps. Formation alerts do not specify retest entry, stop, target or exit; extended averages remain reference levels and can change at a new same-side gap.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Both bars shadows are divided by the current candle range r; the bar-two shadow is not divided by its own range as described.
findings.action: Document this source discrepancy and separately validate r[2] for the prior-shadow ratio.

findings.evidence: The raw alertconditions report detected gaps, while the author describes potential fill/support/resistance areas. Prior contract promotes these formation notifications to entries without a retest or execution rule.
findings.action: Keep gap formation as context unless an explicit authored strategy is added; no close-only timing is enforced by source.

1S2VOnJP.author: LuxAlgo
1S2VOnJP.summary: Highlights confirmed swing areas, their revisit counts and estimated volume, with optional count/volume filtering. The author explicitly says pivot labels are retrospective and should not be traded as realtime signals.
1S2VOnJP.requirements: Confirm symmetric pivots after Pivot Lookback bars and retain the wick-extremity/full-range area choice. Counts and volume process bars at that same lag; volume may use overlapping intrabars. A strict close through the swing extreme makes its line dashed. Filtering, labels and bullish/bearish interpretation of a broken swing do not supply an entry/exit lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

k5QMLWCA.author: LuxAlgo
k5QMLWCA.summary: A daily or monthly calendar classifies sentiment using regression slope, accumulated changes or position within an interval range. The author warns that historical boundary-line colors change as the interval develops.
k5QMLWCA.requirements: Respect frequency, UTC offset and optional date cutoff. reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

wRtmtWIQ.author: LuxAlgo

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

bmFFb5Rt.author: LuxAlgo
bmFFb5Rt.summary: Highlights four ICT killzones and retracement levels derived from the active zone range. Levels evolve during a zone and optionally extend until the next enabled zone.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

C0cC294Q.author: LuxAlgo
C0cC294Q.summary: Detects fair-value gaps, opening gaps and volume imbalances, with configurable width filters, extension and a dashboard of occurrence/fill counts. Alerts report newly detected imbalances.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

bkb6vZDz.author: LuxAlgo

KvGhxGxY.author: LuxAlgo
KvGhxGxY.summary: Finds volume-pivot order blocks and removes mitigated zones using wick or close mode. Bullish zones span low to midpoint and bearish zones midpoint to high, anchored retrospectively to the volume peak.
KvGhxGxY.requirements: Confirm the volume pivot after the configured lookback and preserve the source price-extreme regime used to classify the zone. Formation and mitigation alerts identify zone events, not trades; a failed bullish block is not a long entry. Wick/close mitigation checks the recent lookback extreme, not merely the newest candle. No stop, target or exit lifecycle is prescribed.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The drawing pool updates only indices still occupied by surviving zones and never hides unused boxes/lines. After mitigation reduces the zone count, obsolete drawings can remain visible.
findings.action: Clear unused pooled objects before interpreting the chart as showing only unmitigated blocks.

findings.evidence: Bull OB/Bear OB plots use offset=-length, while alerts occur on pivot detection. Creation and mitigation can also happen on the same calculation because mitigation checks the whole recent window.
findings.action: Keep pivot anchor and detection times distinct and reject backdated markers or mitigation text as current entries.

CnB3fSph.author: LuxAlgo
CnB3fSph.summary: Combines internal/swing BOS and CHoCH, order blocks, equal extremes, fair-value gaps, prior-period levels and premium/discount zones. The author presents discretionary confirmation/target examples rather than a universal strategy.
CnB3fSph.requirements: Keep internal and swing structure events distinct, with their separate pivot lengths, bias, confluence and display options. Structure labels describe breaks; OB-breakout alerts describe failed zones, not entries in the named block direction. EQH/EQL, FVGs and premium/discount references are context. Suggested stops and targets in screenshots do not define a universal lifecycle. Preserve current-bar timing, retrospective label anchors, selected FVG timeframe and update-specific alert behavior.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior contract labels all structure breaks as entries, whereas author uses them within discretionary confirmation examples; no execution lifecycle is encoded. OB-breakout direction denotes the broken zone, with bullish OB removed on downward penetration and bearish OB on upward penetration.
findings.action: Keep exact event semantics and require a separately specified strategy before treating a structure event as an entry; never trade mitigation by its bullish/bearish name.

findings.evidence: FVG request.security uses lookahead_on with unshifted high[0]/low[0] and checks the new timeframe boundary. On higher timeframes historical detection can use that period future extrema, unlike the prior safe-lookahead characterization.
findings.action: Do not use this optional FVG branch as causal historical evidence without a confirmed-period rewrite and validation.

findings.evidence: Bearish gap is stored with top=currentHigh and bottom=last2Low even though currentHigh<last2Low; deletion tests high>top, so it removes on penetration of the lower edge rather than the upper edge.
findings.action: Normalize bearish gap boundaries in a separately validated implementation and preserve source parity differences.

findings.evidence: Structure labels are placed halfway between pivot and break indices, while pivots themselves are confirmed after configured lag; alertconditions have no bar-close guard.
findings.action: Track break detection time separately from label position and explicitly configure confirmation.

xtuVIaa8.author: LuxAlgo
xtuVIaa8.summary: Subtracts a reversed-coefficient Hull average from the ordinary Hull average. Cumulative absolute-value bands identify extremes; dots mark potential reversals when oscillator direction turns beyond a band.
xtuVIaa8.requirements: Preserve length, multiplier and source, and distinguish zero-sign trend context from extreme-turn dots. Bullish dots arise on state transition to rising below the lower band; bearish dots mirror above the upper band. State is reset by band crosses, so every local slope reversal is not a new dot. These are potential reversal candidates without stops, targets, exits or guaranteed reversal.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The oscillator retains os until a band cross or opposite eligible state; circles require os changes. Repeated turns within the same extreme excursion need not print repeated dots.
findings.action: Reproduce state transitions and cumulative band history; do not replace the signal with a stateless slope comparison.

findings.evidence: Neither the page nor source defines a trade lifecycle or an opposite-dot exit, and plots can change on the live bar.
findings.action: Keep dot candidates separate from execution approval and specify close timing independently.

Et6YD2t4.author: LuxAlgo
Et6YD2t4.summary: Measures compression by correlating the logarithm of converging-envelope width with time and scaling the result to a percentage-like index. High readings indicate stronger squeezing, sometimes including retracements.
Et6YD2t4.requirements: Preserve convergence factor, correlation length and source. Values above 80 are highlighted as compression context, with no direction. The author discusses a separate price breakout as the directional decision; that breakout, stop, target and exit are not implemented. Convergence/period choices affect sensitivity and do not establish performance.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The index takes log(max-min) without a positive-width guard, while convergence and length inputs have no bounds. Degenerate envelope widths or invalid parameters can produce undefined results.
findings.action: Validate parameters and distinguish unavailable index values from low compression.

L1NqQsyw.author: LuxAlgo
L1NqQsyw.summary: An adaptive signal moving average is intended as the slower component of a crossover system. It follows the ordinary average in trending conditions and drifts away during ranges, with separate line and price-position colors.
L1NqQsyw.requirements: Preserve period, source, correlation threshold, retained direction and prior-value recurrence. Area color shows source above/below the signal; line color changes only in the trending branch using the previous source relative to its average. The author leaves the faster average and full crossover strategy unspecified. No standalone entry, stop, target or exit is encoded.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The signal average uses configurable src, but its R-squared regime estimate always correlates close with bar_index. Custom sources therefore do not control the full calculation.
findings.action: Retain close-based regime detection or explicitly validate a source-based variant.

findings.evidence: The prior contract says correlation/color can change only at close; no confirmed-bar gate exists and current close contributes to R-squared.
findings.action: Treat live output as provisional and define bar-close consumption explicitly.

pzUpBSIm.author: LuxAlgo
pzUpBSIm.summary: Candlestick patterns pull channel boundaries toward price. The author offers channel-boundary breaks, midpoint crosses, or patterns aligned with the channel-average trend as different approaches.
pzUpBSIm.requirements: Choose one authored variant explicitly. For trend-aligned patterns, require bullish pattern with price above channel average or bearish pattern below it; raw labels alone lack that filter. Preserve pattern toggles, stochastic context, convergence and smoothing. Engulfing patterns default off, and both directions share BE text. Channel and midpoint crosses are distinct choices. No stop, target or exit is specified.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: All enabled pattern labels are emitted on their candle condition, without the channel-average trend confirmation described for the trend-aligned entry approach.
findings.action: Do not treat every pattern label as a fully qualified trend-aligned entry; add the selected variant conditions.

findings.evidence: The engulfing conditions require close beyond the prior open and opposite body signs, but do not require current open to engulf the prior close.
findings.action: Preserve this source-specific pattern definition instead of substituting a textbook full-body engulf.

jWY4Uiez.author: LuxAlgo
jWY4Uiez.summary: Detects fair-value gaps and tracks mitigation. The author explicitly offers trend-following entries on bullish/bearish formation, alongside a separate contrarian interpretation of filled gaps.
jWY4Uiez.requirements: For the formation variant, long on a new bullish FVG and short on a new bearish FVG, preserving intervening-close and strict relative-width conditions, timeframe and timestamp deduplication. Mitigation requires chart close beyond the far edge and is not automatically an exit or reverse entry. Dynamic areas and static boxes are different displays. Stops, targets and full execution timing remain unspecified.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The prior context-only contract says gaps are not entries, but the author expressly permits going long on bullish formation and short on bearish formation as a trend-following approach; raw formation alertconditions use increased detection counts.
findings.action: Record this as an explicit optional authored entry variant, requiring separate lifecycle and timing validation.

findings.evidence: The prose bearish formula uses a negative-threshold comparison despite a positive gap ratio; source correctly requires (low[2]-high)/high > threshold.
findings.action: Use the actual positive-gap threshold and preserve the prose discrepancy.

findings.evidence: Auto threshold is cumulative mean relative candle range, not detected gap heights; dashboard shows count and mitigation share but no average fill duration promised in the opening description.
findings.action: Describe the implemented threshold/statistics and do not infer missing duration evidence.

findings.evidence: Selected higher-timeframe detect() has no confirmed-period offset, and current chart values drive mitigation without a close guard.
findings.action: Keep HTF/live results provisional until an explicit confirmation policy is applied.

HGlMiFRz.author: LuxAlgo
HGlMiFRz.summary: Compares price against an inclusive range of simple moving-average periods and identifies the closest period, with smoothing and optional normalization. Proximity measures period closeness, not trend direction.
HGlMiFRz.requirements: Preserve source, valid minimum/maximum period ordering and smoothing. Price-above counts provide trend context; proximity can highlight movement toward longer averages without determining a side. No threshold crossing is an authored entry or exit, and no lifecycle exists.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: With normalization off, the Price Above MAs output adds minimum length to the smoothed count, so it is not the advertised raw number of averages below price.
findings.action: Document the offset scale or validate removal of the minimum-length addition.

findings.evidence: Normalized proximity divides (period-minimum) by maximum-minimum+1; even the maximum period maps below 100. Ties select the last iterated period.
findings.action: Preserve the scale and tie rule; do not assume a 100 endpoint for the largest period.

WtgiwXjO.author: LuxAlgo
WtgiwXjO.summary: Fits polynomial channels separately within timeframe intervals. The author explicitly acknowledges future-data access and historical results that differ from realtime behavior.
WtgiwXjO.requirements: Treat historical curves as retrospective fits. Preserve polynomial degree, timeframe, source and residual-width multiplier. The live-display option cannot make future-fitted historical segments causal. Alerts set on plots would need an independently defined causal model, entry and lifecycle; none is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: A lookahead_on outer request exposes the full interval lower-timeframe source array at its boundary, then fits all those samples.
findings.action: Exclude this fit from causal historical strategy evidence unless the data/fit timing is redesigned and separately validated.

findings.evidence: Show fit for new bars controls whether the current polynomial evaluation is assigned to out on realtime bars; coefficient fitting still occurs only at timeframe changes with K>1.
findings.action: Describe it as displaying/evaluating the stored model, not guaranteed refitting to each incoming bar.

findings.evidence: The fit only checks K>1 before inverting the polynomial normal matrix; degree+1 can exceed K or be numerically singular.
findings.action: Validate sample count and solve stability before any implementation.

srkcHQMv.author: LuxAlgo
srkcHQMv.summary: A slow average converges faster as a trend produces new rolling highs or lows, with a companion fast average and directional fill.
srkcHQMv.requirements: Preserve length, increment, fast parameter and source; reset smoothing at source/slow-average crosses and use the prior smoothing factor for the current slow-average update. New extremes are high/low based. Crosses are described as more timely, but no specific entry, stop, target or exit rule is authored.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Author specifies smoothing-factor increment 2/(Increment+1), while source initializes k=1/incr and adds it on qualifying new extremes.
findings.action: Record the actual increment formula; validate any formula change as a distinct variant.

findings.evidence: Alpha can increase above one because no cap is applied; the resulting recurrence can overshoot price rather than simply approach it.
findings.action: Do not assume convex smoothing or cap alpha silently; validate the intended behavior.

AEh4XKbZ.author: LuxAlgo
AEh4XKbZ.summary: Constructs price-occupancy bins above and below the visible close mean using standard-deviation spacing. Counts use high/low overlap; strongest bins on each side provide POC references.
AEh4XKbZ.requirements: Require the visible interval, bins per side, deviation multiplier and relative/raw width mode. A candle may count in multiple bins; this is occupancy, not volume or a probability distribution. POCs are possible support/resistance references without entries, stops, targets or exits. Changing the chart window recalculates the whole histogram.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Flat visible prices or zero deviation multiplier can produce zero-width bins and zero maximum count; relative widths then divide by zero.
findings.action: Handle zero spread/count explicitly and report unavailable bins rather than fabricating profile levels.

uc5DGskn.author: LuxAlgo
uc5DGskn.summary: Detrends price against Parabolic SAR and normalizes SAR within the extrema of its current trend. SAR extrema indicate trend direction and the zero area can suggest an approaching reversal.
uc5DGskn.requirements: Preserve acceleration, increment and maximum settings and extrema resets on price/SAR crossings. SAR dots and oscillator levels are analytical context; the author does not supply a complete entry, stop, target or exit policy.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

zAkeVs4R.author: LuxAlgo
zAkeVs4R.summary: Fits a least-squares polynomial to recent source values and extrapolates it. Lock Forecast freezes the fit and continues evaluating its polynomial as new observations arrive.
zAkeVs4R.requirements: Preserve length, degree, extrapolation and lock state. Unlocked history is a last-bar refit, not a historical signal series. The author warns that future polynomial continuation is uncertain and high degrees are noisy/numerically unstable. No trade lifecycle is specified.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Length permits zero and is not constrained above polynomial degree; the inverse of the design normal matrix can therefore be singular.
findings.action: Reject insufficient observations for the selected degree before exposing a fit.

YaniRMVC.author: LuxAlgo
YaniRMVC.summary: Compares bullish and bearish distances beyond EMA-based Bollinger bands over a rolling window. The dominant component indicates directional strength rather than supplying an execution rule.
YaniRMVC.requirements: Preserve length, multiplier and source. Each component sums positive distance beyond its band and divides by total absolute distance to that band; it is not a count of breakout candles. No entries, stops, targets or exits are specified.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Raw code sums distances to upper/lower bands, then normalizes by summed absolute distances; a candle-count interpretation loses magnitude weighting.
findings.action: Retain the distance-weighted formula in descriptions and any implementation.

eyakzwYP.author: LuxAlgo
eyakzwYP.summary: Detects regular and inverted three-candle horns, draws a confirmation level and a measured-range target, and marks directional confirmation breakouts.
eyakzwYP.requirements: Preserve normalized horn threshold, a middle candle inside the outer highs/lows, and crossing into the threshold. Long confirmation crosses above the three-bar high for inverted horns; short crosses below the low for regular horns. One signal is armed per changed confirmation level. Targets extend one pattern range; stops, fills and post-target management are not supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Detection requires ta.crossunder of normalized outer-high/low difference, not merely a difference below threshold. The signal arm resets only when lvl changes, so an equal-level new pattern does not necessarily rearm.
findings.action: Preserve threshold transition and level-change arming instead of detecting every qualifying three-candle shape.

findings.evidence: Targets are lines only; B/S plotshapes provide no order, stop, target-fill or closing state.
findings.action: Keep entry confirmation separate from any independently specified execution and risk policy.

ZX1z1Z2r.author: LuxAlgo
ZX1z1Z2r.summary: Displays lower-timeframe candle bodies colored by their volume within each chart bar, with interval boundaries for the highest-volume intrabars.
ZX1z1Z2r.requirements: Require a lower chart timeframe for the requested data. Colors compare volume within each chart bar, not across the chart. Later bodies can hide earlier higher-volume bodies, as the author explicitly notes. Full-range line color follows chart candle direction. No entry or trade lifecycle is defined.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

ECSfVssE.author: LuxAlgo
ECSfVssE.summary: Builds an upper/lower channel around Supertrend behavior and plots their average to reduce noise and identify directional support/resistance context.
ECSfVssE.requirements: Preserve ATR length, multiplier, Supertrend state and channel recurrence. Rising/falling channel behavior and extrema are references; channel changes are not authored automatic entries, stops, targets or exits.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

xyCba4gl.author: LuxAlgo
xyCba4gl.summary: Tracks significant deviations from a central level using successive Fibonacci multiples of a manual distance or ATR(200). A completed sequence reanchors the center at close and resets the multiplier.
xyCba4gl.requirements: Checks/crosses distinguish deviations aligned/opposed to central-level trend. Break labels indicate a new center; outer levels are support/resistance references. Preserve strict distance exceedance and sequence reset. No authored entry execution or fixed trade-management policy is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior contract treats B/S as entries and Target/Stop as trade management. Author describes breaks, potential reversals and support/resistance; source labels track center changes and the levels continue changing with distance.
findings.action: Keep the authored trend-break interpretation; any trading variant needs explicit entry and level-freezing policy.

findings.evidence: Target/Stop plots are unavailable on the center-change bar and later use evolving Fibonacci/ATR distance.
findings.action: Do not infer initial executable protection from these display plots.

CQScywKe.author: LuxAlgo
CQScywKe.summary: Identifies completed regular/inverted Bart shapes from median-filter edges and their intervening range. The author explicitly presents historical pattern study, not real-time pattern entries.
CQScywKe.requirements: Preserve median lookback, ATR edge sensitivity, range-to-edge threshold, inverted option and display mode. Sentiment table reflects edge state, not an executable completed-pattern entry. Source places sampled prices half a median window back. No stops, targets or exits are supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: With inverted detection enabled, the first upward state transition can enter the pattern branch with only one stored edge; array.get(ds,1) has no size guard.
findings.action: Require two edges and a valid intervening range before testing a pattern.

findings.evidence: The prior generic non-repainting timing omits the explicit author warning and source half-window historical coordinates.
findings.action: Record confirmation-time availability separately from historical shape coordinates.

FhuOxgN9.author: LuxAlgo
FhuOxgN9.summary: Draws diagonal Fibonacci or equidistant support/resistance grids. July 2023 updates replace the original rolling lookback with user-selected anchor times.
FhuOxgN9.requirements: Require two ordered anchors on chart bars and preserve ratio/resolution and extension settings. Final interval extrema become known only at the second anchor; earlier grid segments are retrospective drawings. The latest note says rightward extension. No entry, stop, target or exit is defined.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Latest release says diagonals extend only right, but two source line families use extend.left while the others use extend.right.
findings.action: Verify rendered extension against the latest release before claiming visual fidelity; do not derive historical signals from anchored grids.

BEUgu3o1.author: LuxAlgo
BEUgu3o1.summary: Resets trailing high/low extrema and their average on confirmed pivots to show trend, ranging behavior and support/resistance. Non-backpainted mode is now the default.
BEUgu3o1.requirements: Preserve configurable symmetric pivot lag, current-time output by default, and optional historical offset plus last-bar extension. Higher highs/lower lows indicate trend context; pivot markers are not entries. No trade lifecycle is supplied.

2GtawcFy.author: LuxAlgo
2GtawcFy.summary: A manually anchored cubic Bézier drawing extrapolates a curve from four control prices. The author cautions that a good fit to market observations is not its primary purpose.
2GtawcFy.requirements: Require four explicit control points and extrapolation length. The curve passes through first/last control points, not generally the middle pair. findings.action: Validate anchor order and distinct endpoints.

vDGd9X9y.author: LuxAlgo

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

OxJJqZiN.author: LuxAlgo
OxJJqZiN.summary: Connects confirmed pivots with inferred missed reversals and support/resistance levels. A current ghost estimates the next reversal and continuously readjusts.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

BbHc0nIt.author: LuxAlgo
BbHc0nIt.summary: Fits two Bézier arches to alternating body extrema and reports similarity to a McDonald’s logo. The author explicitly limits this meme to descriptive entertainment.
BbHc0nIt.requirements: Preserve rolling-extrema sensitivity, delayed body-swing detection, historical marker offsets and optional latest-bar vertex. Score is symmetry of the drawn shape, not predictive confidence. No entries or trade lifecycle should be inferred.

findings.action: Describe the actual delayed rolling-extrema method and last-bar redraw instead of a conventional pivot model.

cdU6E9rm.author: LuxAlgo
cdU6E9rm.summary: Accumulates live volume changes at observed tick prices, then draws per-candle footprint bins at bar confirmation. Settings changes reset accumulated history.
cdU6E9rm.requirements: Preserve ATR/manual bin sizing, raw/percentage values and appearance. This requires live observations and cannot be reconstructed faithfully from ordinary OHLCV bars. reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior contract describes buy/sell delta; source stores volume-prev without an aggressor-side or price-direction sign.
findings.action: Describe estimated traded volume per sampled price slice, not order-flow delta.

findings.evidence: Confirmed-bar drawing occurs before the latest tick is appended, and strict value < top excludes prices at the candle high.

IYL88A1N.author: LuxAlgo
IYL88A1N.summary: Marks first upward/downward breaks of projected pivot trendlines. The 2023 update removes historical offsets from B labels while retaining optional backpainted lines.
IYL88A1N.requirements: Preserve symmetric pivot confirmation lag, ATR/Stdev/Linreg slope and one breakout per line. Up/down breaks are independent, with no authored position close or risk lifecycle. The displayed B is directionally ambiguous without its channel/style. Backpaint setting must not change breakout timing.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.action: Preserve reset/latch behavior rather than replacing it with a simple crossing test.

1O935I6Y.author: LuxAlgo
1O935I6Y.summary: Averages RSI across a minimum-to-maximum period range, reports proportions above/below thresholds, and uses these proportions to adapt channel levels.
