x20TQQYT.author: LuxAlgo
x20TQQYT.summary: Anchored VWAP and volume-weighted deviation bands reset on periodic, high/low, trend, external-cross or external-event conditions. They can serve as references or inputs to a separately defined system.
x20TQQYT.requirements: Preserve anchor/start-at-first-bar choice, selected price source, event and multiplier. External Event resets whenever its series is nonzero; Start never resets after anchoring. Bands are hidden on reset bars. No complete crossover strategy or trade lifecycle is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Author describes higher-high/lower-low Donchian trend changes. Source instead rounds stochastic position of the selected source within its own range, changing state around its midpoint.
findings.action: Document the midpoint-state variant or implement the authored extreme-based rule as a separately identified correction.

findings.evidence: Reset VWAP equals the chosen src, not necessarily closing price as the prose states; source supports open/high/low and averages.
findings.action: Preserve selected-source semantics and avoid promising close-based resets for all settings.

IfTGj063.author: LuxAlgo
IfTGj063.summary: Classifies manually selected XABC anchors as Bat, Gartley, Butterfly or Crab, projects D and a potential reversal zone, and alerts on price crossing these references.
IfTGj063.requirements: Require manual anchor times and XA precision; avoid overlapping tolerance ranges. Preserve strict ratio bounds and pattern priority. PRZ is D plus/minus 38.2% of absolute DX. Touch/cross alerts are context without an authored automatic entry or trade lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: D is only a time input: its price is projected from XA and pattern ratio rather than read from the selected D candle. Even no recognized pattern falls back to Bat-ratio D and PRZ.
findings.action: Describe projected D and distinguish unclassified reference alerts from validated harmonic patterns.

findings.evidence: Crab tooltip states minimum CD/BC 2.618, while detection uses 2.224.
findings.action: Resolve the tooltip/detection discrepancy explicitly before relying on classifications.

findings.evidence: Alert tests crossing either boundary without requiring the close to remain between both boundaries, so a gap across the whole zone also qualifies.
findings.action: Keep boundary-cross semantics distinct from a confirmed close inside the PRZ.

2HmHKuo1.author: LuxAlgo
2HmHKuo1.summary: Provides manually anchored Fibonacci retracements, arcs, circles, fans, time zones and a golden-ratio spiral. Ratios and selected tools are configurable.
2HmHKuo1.requirements: Require explicit start/end times and selected-source prices. Geometry is a support/resistance or timing reference, without entries or trade lifecycle. Spiral appearance can distort on discontinuous stock/forex time axes, as the author notes.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prose calls time-zone lines horizontal and the spiral seven turns. Source draws vertical time lines and sweeps t through 7*pi, or 3.5 complete rotations.
findings.action: Use actual vertical-line and angular-span behavior in descriptions.

findings.evidence: The second fan family rounds its price endpoint to an integer, materially altering geometry on small-priced instruments.
findings.action: Preserve price precision when recreating fan geometry.

JzrxU03D.author: LuxAlgo
JzrxU03D.summary: A circular dashboard displays normalized RSI, stochastic, correlation, Williams %R, percent rank and MFI, plus their average sentiment.
JzrxU03D.requirements: Preserve separate oscillator periods, source and visual spacing/width. The average uses normalized rounded arc angles; it is not calibrated confidence. Stochastic uses source for high/low inputs and Williams %R retains native OHLC inputs. No entries, stops, targets or exits are defined.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

yvDyq0pv.author: LuxAlgo
yvDyq0pv.summary: A periodic approximation to moon phases drives selectable long/short events or higher/lower moon-price regimes. Opposite conditions close the other side and submit an entry at bar close.
yvDyq0pv.requirements: Preserve reference date, approximate cycle, independently selected sides and process-orders-on-close timing. The 2021 update changed defaults; current source buys Full Moon and sells New Moon, unlike original prose. No protective stop or target exists. Historical examples omit friction and do not establish effectiveness.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Despite a New Moon Reference Date input, the phase is (reference + time + two days) modulo cycle, not elapsed time since that reference; choosing a new reference does not anchor newmoon at that date.
findings.action: Verify the intended lunar epoch/formula before calling this a faithful calendar strategy.

findings.evidence: Higher/Lower Moon comparisons remain true between events rather than being gated to a new/full moon bar. Independent long and short blocks can both run if inputs select the same condition.
findings.action: Preserve persistent-regime behavior or explicitly select event-only execution and conflict policy; do not infer stops or runtime approval.

1nJPItpz.author: LuxAlgo
1nJPItpz.summary: Counts selected-source prices within sloping bins of a fitted regression channel to highlight occupied trend regions. Channel width derives from regression residual deviation.
1nJPItpz.requirements: Preserve length, source, deviation multiplier and current-window fit. Histogram is last-bar descriptive occupancy, not volume, probability or a historical trading signal. No trade lifecycle is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Bins Number allocates that many boundaries but counts bins-1 intervals; both strict bounds exclude observations exactly on any boundary.
findings.action: Describe the actual interval count and choose explicit edge inclusion for a faithful histogram.

Iko0E2kL.author: LuxAlgo
Iko0E2kL.summary: A Gaussian-kernel trend estimate plus/minus mean absolute deviation identifies contrarian extremes. Default smoothing refits historical values; optional endpoint mode removes that historical refit.
Iko0E2kL.requirements: Preserve bandwidth, multiplier, source and smoothing mode. Lower-envelope breaks suggest long reversals and upper breaks short reversals, not guaranteed entries alone. The author explicitly discourages standalone reliance. No stop, target or exit policy exists; historical refit arrows are not confirmed historical trades.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The complete source contains no alertcondition or alert calls despite the author description promising integrated alerts.
findings.action: Do not advertise native alert delivery without adding and validating an explicit mode-aware event channel.

findings.evidence: Repainting mode rebuilds historical labels from the latest full-window fit, without stored first-occurrence timestamps; endpoint plots instead use current close, even when another Source is selected.
findings.action: Keep modes and event provenance separate; do not interpret refitted historical label locations as real-time entry availability.

findings.evidence: The loop accumulates min(499,n-1)+1 errors but divides by min(499,n-1), inflating band deviation relative to the mean.
findings.action: Use or explicitly document the actual normalization; zero bandwidth also needs validation.

YPswXly5.author: LuxAlgo
YPswXly5.summary: Projects equidistant fan lines from an anchored linear-regression channel. The July 2023 update replaces the original recent lookback with user-selected anchors.
YPswXly5.requirements: Require ordered anchors, source, residual-deviation multiplier, lines per side and initial fan position. The complete interval fit is available only at its final anchor. Lines are support/resistance references; the linked broadening-wedge measure rule is optional and not fully specified in this page or implemented as trade management.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Variance/correlation divisions are unguarded for a single observation or flat prices; final drawing also requires a bar time exactly matching x2.
findings.action: Validate anchors and sample variation, reporting unavailable geometry rather than fabricated levels.

Y8v4W3mX.author: LuxAlgo
Y8v4W3mX.summary: Selects a historical segment by greatest/least correlation with recent observations and projects its price changes cumulatively, around a mean, or around an extrapolated regression.
Y8v4W3mX.requirements: Preserve evaluation/forecast windows, source, similarity mode and construction. Author recommends detrended periodic inputs. This last-bar forecast is recalculated and supplies no entries, stops, targets or exits.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior contract calls the projected changes subsequent to the matched window. Source e indexes the selected historical segment itself, from older to newer observations.
findings.action: Describe the actual selected-segment replay rather than a learned subsequent-path model.

findings.evidence: Array slices exclude the end index, so correlation uses fcast-1 observations while the highlighted reference and forecast use fcast. Forecast Window 1 produces empty slices.
findings.action: Align advertised window length with actual samples and validate minimum usable length.

qAkfJgFu.author: LuxAlgo
qAkfJgFu.summary: Uses closes at confirmed volume peaks as support/resistance and counts bullish/bearish candles between the displayed levels. The later update renames Peak Activity Levels to Liquidity Levels.
qAkfJgFu.requirements: Preserve symmetric volume-pivot lag, number of levels, histogram window and styling. Levels are references requiring additional analysis, not entry signals. The histogram counts closes and candle direction, not liquidity depth or traded volume. No trade lifecycle is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Last-bar pals.sort mutates the persistent level array; after that state commits, unshift/pop on a new peak removes a price-sorted endpoint rather than necessarily the oldest level.
findings.action: Keep chronological storage separate from a sorted display copy.

findings.evidence: Histogram boxes iterate show-1 entries and access pals[index+1] without requiring that many detected peaks.
findings.action: Wait for sufficient levels or limit drawing to available adjacent pairs.

XagQA3d6.author: LuxAlgo
XagQA3d6.summary: Averages stochastic positions across lengths four through the selected maximum, with configurable pre/post smoothing. Circles mark returns above 20 or below 80 for earlier trend-direction assessment.
XagQA3d6.requirements: Preserve inclusive periods, smoothing methods and level-cross direction. LSMA can overshoot and circles can be disrupted by retracements, as the author notes. These are directional events without a complete authored entry or stop/target/exit policy.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: No minimum length of four is enforced and each stochastic divides by its local range without a flat-series guard.
findings.action: Validate period range and define unavailable results for constant samples.

fLtr5XhT.author: LuxAlgo
fLtr5XhT.summary: Calculates hypothetical position size, open price movement, risk/reward and stop/target levels from a manual entry or external-cross reference.
fLtr5XhT.requirements: Preserve selected side, account/risk inputs and independent percent/absolute-price/ATR/range modes. ATR/range values remain dynamic. External-cross mode uses the next bar open after either-direction cross; it is not an autonomous strategy. This receipt authorizes no change to the existing risk or margin settings.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior contract says only typed stops/targets and no cross entry; source implements four level methods and a previous-bar external-cross-derived entry.
findings.action: Represent all authored calculator modes without treating calculated levels as executed orders.

findings.evidence: Prose says entry where a cross occurred, but valuewhen(cross(...)[1],open,0) selects the following bar open.
findings.action: Document next-open timing and preserve configured side separately from cross direction.

findings.evidence: Position size divides by signed entry-stop distance without rejecting zero/wrong-side stops. Displayed P&L is per-unit price change, not position-size-weighted account profit.
findings.action: Validate calculator inputs and label units; do not infer fills, protective orders or realized P&L.

amRCTgFw.author: LuxAlgo
amRCTgFw.summary: Gaussian-kernel smoothing offers a causal endpoint series or a historical refit. Rising/falling output describes trend; triangles in repainting mode mark retrospectively fitted turning points.
amRCTgFw.requirements: Preserve bandwidth, source and smoothing mode. The author discourages real-time predictive use of repeated turning labels. Endpoint mode has no triangles; historical-fit triangles are not contemporaneously available entries. No stop, target or exit is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior contract promotes repaint-mode triangles to entries and calls this an envelope. Source has a single smoother and retrospective turning labels; the page describes structural analysis.
findings.action: Keep smoother context distinct from the separate envelope publication and remove implied author approval of automatic arrow entries.

findings.evidence: Bandwidth permits zero although the Gaussian divides by h squared; endpoint mode also needs the full 500-source history.
findings.action: Require positive bandwidth and sufficient history before interpreting output.

HBuT6e1v.author: LuxAlgo
HBuT6e1v.summary: Displays same-type pivot percentage changes and spacing, with cumulative averages and projected next-pivot times. The author explicitly says pivot labels are descriptive and not real-time trade signals.
HBuT6e1v.requirements: Preserve symmetric pivot lag, historical label positions and separate high/low statistics. Forecast time is latest pivot origin plus mean same-type spacing, subject to the source drawing limit. No entries or trade lifecycle exist.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The low-pivot forecast branch is outside show_fcast, so disabling Show Forecasted Pivots only hides the high-pivot forecasts.
findings.action: Apply the display toggle consistently if repairing the drawing tool.

findings.evidence: Mean percentage-change denominator counts only nonzero changes, excluding equal-price pivots rather than averaging all successive pivots.
findings.action: Document exclusion or count valid zero-change observations in the mean.

a2PJSO1p.author: LuxAlgo
a2PJSO1p.summary: Connects delayed rolling-extrema turning points and offsets channel boundaries by maximum candle-body deviations. A mutable last leg extends to the current close.
a2PJSO1p.requirements: Preserve length-based confirmation and historical offsets. This is not the percentage-deviation Zig Zag introduced as background. Endpoints use high/low at close-selected extrema; channel deviation uses bodies. Lines, circles and prices are descriptive references without entries or trade lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Historical channel deviation interpolation divides by len-1 while the actual connected endpoints are len bars apart, so measured deviations are against a differently sloped line.
findings.action: Align deviation sampling with the plotted endpoint span when reproducing channel geometry.

9K34g20s.author: LuxAlgo
9K34g20s.summary: Displays selectable normalized oscillator spokes and an overall sentiment meter, with individual or global periods. A value near the midpoint suggests balanced/ranging readings.
9K34g20s.requirements: Preserve selected spokes, period overrides and indicator-specific normalization. The display is current context, not entry signals or calibrated confidence. No stops, targets or exits exist.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: The first oscillator is appended again to close the polygon, then array.avg(values) includes it in sentiment, double-weighting the first enabled spoke.
findings.action: Compute the average before adding the closing vertex or exclude that duplicate.

findings.evidence: With every oscillator disabled, array.get(values,0) and angular division by zero are unguarded.
findings.action: Require at least one valid oscillator and handle invalid component values.

TXFRoyKF.author: LuxAlgo
TXFRoyKF.summary: Uses preprocessed pixel-color arrays and Pine tables to animate a small image, with chart replay controlling progression. The author also describes preparing alternative GIF frames.
TXFRoyKF.requirements: This is a decorative demonstration with no market inputs, entry logic, stop, target or exit. Preserve table dimensions and three-frame cycling; static pixel data must not be treated as analytical output.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete executable animation logic inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Long pixel-color literal arrays were not individually audited. Not runtime approval.

wgS6EchG.author: LuxAlgo
wgS6EchG.summary: Compares SMA, cascaded-SMA, weighted-average and regression-related direction measures across selected periods. Optional normalization compares their relative changes within each family.
wgS6EchG.requirements: Preserve minimum/maximum period, step, source and normalization mode. Dashboard colors describe direction; the displayed percentage is a sign aggregate, not a trading decision. The author provides directional identities, not a complete strategy or lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: SMA column normalizes src-src[length] without dividing by length; this shares the SMA slope sign but not its magnitude across periods. Other columns likewise use direction-equivalent expressions.
findings.action: Distinguish normalized direction proxies from normalized actual first differences.

findings.evidence: Zero changes color as bearish but contribute half bullish weight to the aggregate percentage because sign(0)=0.
findings.action: Define neutral readings consistently in both cells and summary percentage.

dVau7zqn.author: LuxAlgo
dVau7zqn.summary: Normalizes price relative to Supertrend and adds an adaptive signal and difference histogram. Labels grade the preceding Supertrend signal, while extremes can suggest discretionary exits.
dVau7zqn.requirements: Preserve ATR length/factor, histogram smoothing and optional label/line displays. Histogram sign disagreement can filter flips; overbought/oversold levels are possible exit references, not mandatory closing rules. Check/cross glyphs evaluate the previous opposite trade direction and must not alone identify a new side.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior contract asserts opposite flips as exits and a natural stop, but source only draws oscillator diagnostics and the page offers optional extreme-based exit guidance.
findings.action: Do not promote diagnostic labels or the unplotted Supertrend to an authored executable lifecycle.

findings.evidence: Alpha equals osc squared divided by length, so the signal follows faster at large absolute oscillator values; prose says it is closer when ranging.
findings.action: Describe faster adaptation at trend extremes and slower adaptation near zero.

Mk7UyOFU.author: LuxAlgo
Mk7UyOFU.summary: Uses a sine-based kernel with configurable lag and overshoot, mean-absolute-deviation bands and optional smoothed candles. Alternating extrema provide possible reversal/support/resistance context.
Mk7UyOFU.requirements: Preserve length, lag, overshoot and multiplier. Band selection uses any high/upper or low/lower crossing, with high crossing priority. Smoothed open averages the prior two filtered closes. Suggested crossover systems and band bounces lack an authored full entry/exit lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Allowed length 2 produces zero endpoint weights; beta 0 also collapses weights. Normalization divides by array.sum(b) without a guard.
findings.action: Validate nonzero kernel weight sum and document alpha=0 numerical handling before exposing the filter.

5MggSfGG.author: LuxAlgo
5MggSfGG.summary: Estimates a rolling volume profile and point of control from chart candles, with optional historical rolling POC. The author explicitly distinguishes this estimate from tick-based volume profiles.
5MggSfGG.requirements: Preserve lookback, rows and display settings. POC is a possible support/resistance reference, not an entry. Rolling computation can time out at large settings. No trade lifecycle is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Every overlapping row receives the full candle volume, so volumes are duplicated across rows rather than allocated by traded price or overlap fraction.
findings.action: Describe the estimator explicitly and do not present row sums as actual transacted volume.

findings.evidence: Displayed POC is overwritten by each maximal row, ending at the highest tied bin; rolling POC uses array.indexof and selects the lowest tied bin.
findings.action: Use consistent documented tie resolution if the two POC displays are compared.

EJVwGujI.author: LuxAlgo
EJVwGujI.summary: Draws regression-sloped parallel lines through selected confirmed pivot highs/lows. The author describes retrospective support/resistance drawings and warns about realtime and history-buffer limitations.
EJVwGujI.requirements: Preserve pivot lag, number of pivots and slope multiplier including zero/negative settings. Require enough confirmed pivots within history. Lines do not define entries or trade lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prose says lines do not update on new bars, but barstate.islast creates new lines using a recalculated slope on realtime bars without deleting prior lines.
findings.action: Distinguish immutable old objects from newly accumulated recalculated lines; verify refresh behavior before claiming fixed levels.

findings.evidence: Pivot arrays are varip and insert on every ph/pl evaluation without confirmation or deduplication, so repeated open-bar executions can store duplicate/provisional pivots.
findings.action: Require confirmed unique pivot identities and sufficient array length before creating lines.

Nj6CMJkP.author: LuxAlgo
Nj6CMJkP.summary: A line bounces between rolling source extrema at configurable speed. Author suggests hypothetical price crosses at speed one and extended-line support/resistance at faster speeds.
Nj6CMJkP.requirements: Preserve period, selected source, speed and frozen channel width at each direction change. The author qualifies the proposed applications as experimental and not well suited to a complete crossover system. No signal markers, explicit directional execution, stops, targets or exits are supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

ZIO3hXCd.author: LuxAlgo
ZIO3hXCd.summary: RSI of an adaptive average is paired with a smoothed RSI trigger; the author explicitly proposes their crosses as entry points while reducing sensitivity to retracements.
ZIO3hXCd.requirements: Preserve length, power, source and the RSI-of-error adaptive factor. Cross events need direction from the oscillator versus trigger series; the common circle alone is directionless. The author supplies no stop, target, exit or position-management rules.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior contract classifies the tool solely as context because circles lack direction, but the primary description explicitly calls trigger crosses entry points.
findings.action: Retain the authored entry use and recover crossing direction from series if implementing; do not infer an executable lifecycle.

findings.evidence: With gradient None, crossing circles receive color na even when Circles is On.
findings.action: Do not rely on circle visibility for event detection across display settings.

p8wGCPi6.author: LuxAlgo
p8wGCPi6.summary: TRAMA adapts its smoothing speed to the squared frequency of new rolling highs/lows, becoming more responsive in persistent trends and smoother in ranges.
p8wGCPi6.requirements: Preserve length and source. Extrema detection uses chart highs/lows even when a different source is selected, and either/both extremes count as one event per bar. Suggested crossover or trailing-reference use requires a separately selected system; no entries or trade lifecycle are supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

bpfxYC3a.author: LuxAlgo
bpfxYC3a.summary: Separately accumulates smoothed rising-volume and declining-volume contributions within regression-slope trend regimes. Positive/negative waves represent volume-change direction, while color represents price trend.
bpfxYC3a.requirements: Preserve length, source, linearity smoothing and cumulative-band multiplier. Wave thresholds suggest possible trend reversals but supply no explicit entry, stop, target or exit. Do not read positive volume waves as necessarily bullish or negative waves as necessarily bearish.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Band calculation divides cumulative wave values by bar_index, not elapsed count bar_index+1, and early zero bands can leave gradient ratios undefined.
findings.action: Use documented sample normalization and handle unavailable early thresholds.

0XxPH6A2.author: LuxAlgo
0XxPH6A2.summary: Triangular-smoothed momentum detects regular divergences on first-difference turns, avoiding a centered price-pivot confirmation window. Optional correlation coloring describes oscillator/price alignment.
0XxPH6A2.requirements: Preserve length, source, oscillator sign and comparison with prior same-type turn. Price comparison uses rolling extrema of selected source at turn time. Buy/Sell and circles duplicate the same event. No authored stop, target or opposite-signal exit exists.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Prior contract asserts an opposite-signal exit, but neither explanation nor complete indicator source defines position closing.
findings.action: Keep divergence events separate from any independently specified lifecycle.

findings.evidence: The comparisons store oscillator values on the turn-confirmation bar, not the preceding extremum value, and no barstate.isconfirmed gate protects live turns.
findings.action: Use actual turn-bar values and confirmed availability when producing stable event history.

TsRmOzqT.author: LuxAlgo
TsRmOzqT.summary: Applies arctangent gain shaping to a smoothed-price z-score, using sign for direction and price/oscillator correlation color for potential reversals.
TsRmOzqT.requirements: Preserve length, source and asymmetric gain mapping. Saturation removes divergence detail; negative gain settings reduce that effect. Colors and sign are contextual hints without fixed entries or trade lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Author says gradient is unaffected by pre-gain, but correlation is computed from os after the nonlinear gain transform.
findings.action: Document gain-dependent correlation coloring or compute it from an untransformed series as an explicit variant.

JDFoWQbL.author: LuxAlgo
JDFoWQbL.summary: Marks pivot support/resistance breaks with separate volume-filtered B tags and bullish/bearish wick classifications. Alerts identify volume-qualified directional breaks.
JDFoWQbL.requirements: Preserve left/right pivot lengths plus the extra one-bar delay, volume EMA(5)/EMA(10) threshold and wick predicates. B glyphs require directional channel/style. Wick tags lack the volume filter. No stop, target or exit lifecycle is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: B shapes exclude their wick-classified counterpart, but alerts do not apply wick exclusions or Show Breaks. Wick shapes themselves are not volume-filtered.
findings.action: Treat B shapes, wick shapes and alerts as distinct event channels rather than interchangeable duplicates.

findings.evidence: Support/resistance plots are offset rightBars+1 into the past, while breaks use the currently available delayed level and can vary on an open bar.
findings.action: Do not infer historical level availability from drawn positions; confirm event bars for stable scanning.

yxEJ4Dxw.author: LuxAlgo
yxEJ4Dxw.summary: Labels confirmed swing highs/lows with structural classification and one selected candle pattern for studying reversal associations. The author explicitly warns that labels are backpainted.
yxEJ4Dxw.requirements: Preserve symmetric pivot delay, historical origin and pattern-priority order. HH/HL/LH/LL and candle descriptions are analytical observations, not authored automatic entries. No trade lifecycle is provided.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: beareng repeats the bullish-engulfing condition exactly; earlier bulleng priority means Bearish Engulfing can never be selected.
findings.action: Correct the bearish body-direction and engulfing predicates before claiming six supported patterns.

findings.evidence: Prior contract promotes hammer/star pivot combinations to entries; the primary page describes retrospective study of pattern association only.
findings.action: Retain context-only interpretation and never execute at the backdated label origin.

YDpNmgQV.author: LuxAlgo
YDpNmgQV.summary: Demonstrates rolling nearest-rank percentiles using sorted arrays, including proposed median, quartile, minimum and maximum use cases.
YDpNmgQV.requirements: Preserve window, percentage and source. The plotted statistic can support external analysis but supplies no entries, stops, targets or exits. Validate a positive window and sufficient source history.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

findings.evidence: Source uses round(p/100*length)-1 rather than the nearest-rank ceiling rule. Percentage zero yields index -1 rather than explicitly selecting the minimum as promised.
findings.action: Implement or document rank rounding explicitly and clamp the zero-percent endpoint to the first sorted observation.

reconciliation.scope: Full author explanation and all available updates; complete non-comment raw Pine inspected against prior hash-pinned contract. Not runtime approval.

3XE8qqfr.requirements: The five alternate classifications need not agree. Volume weighting changes classification input but volume still scales output. Fixed shape priorities/thresholds are assumptions, not significance tests. Suggested divergences require discretionary price comparison; shape labels and polarity do not define native entries.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

1SytPYEb.author: Zeiierman
1SytPYEb.summary: Tracks consecutive directional candle runs and their initial opens. An opposite close through a valid run open confirms CISD; solid levels denote a changed trend and dashed levels repeat the existing direction. Optional pivot sweeps and MSS provide additional context.
1SytPYEb.requirements: Respect minimum run length, minimum confirmation age and expiry. Confirmed delivery shifts differ from setup creation, setup expiry and candle-color changes. Pivot sweeps and MSS use their own delays; the author supplies no stop/target lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Both author and raw alert text identify expiry of an unconfirmed setup. The source contract labels these exits despite no position state. bullExpired/bearExpired test setup age, not an open trade.
findings.action: Classify setup expiry as information; do not close or open a trade solely from expiry.

3HViTWK9.author: Zeiierman

TA1v6Y21.author: Zeiierman

Persistent trend/extreme alerts describe states. Upper-band re-entry crosses downward despite its Bullish title; lower-band re-entry is the inverse. No stop, target or exit rules exist.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.marker: Bullish Upper Band Reentry / Bearish Lower Band Reentry

VrTL3VwF.author: Zeiierman
VrTL3VwF.summary: An RSI analogue classifier combines rank and confidence with trend, volatility and chop filters. The classifier's Long/Short outputs are distinct from SuperTrend regime flips.

Ce4kPpHV.author: Zeiierman
Ce4kPpHV.summary: Candle flips with an ATR body minimum create prior-candle zones. Quality ranking combines ATR size, volume, EMA alignment, displacement, mitigation and age; hidden zones remain stored and compatible overlaps can merge.
Ce4kPpHV.requirements: Author advises evaluating retest reaction and internal pressure rather than immediately trading zone creation. findings.evidence: Author describes immediate reaction and respected alignment as qualities of strong retests. Raw touched condition checks one-sided penetration for each stored zone and lacks reaction confirmation, supporting the prior unconfirmed-marker finding.
findings.action: Retain context-only classification and avoid treating every touch as an entry.

0O1X4gMd.author: Zeiierman
0O1X4gMd.summary: Compares current ROC, RSI, ATR percentage and relative volume against historical states, then similarity-weights the selected matches' internal momentum to displace current price. Smoothing and slope form the displayed average/cloud; historical match boxes illustrate resemblance.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Description associates color with historically positive/negative momentum, but raw color/alerts use the slope of the smoothed projected line, which also incorporates current price. These are not the same signed quantity.
findings.action: Document actual slope-based color behavior and retain contextual interpretation; do not equate color with a forecast or measured historical payoff.

Z4h7vDqN.author: Zeiierman
Z4h7vDqN.summary: Stores three-bar imbalances, ranks active zones, displays a configurable top set and shows synthetic directional-strength bars. Hidden zones remain tracked; mitigation and age reduce rank.
Z4h7vDqN.requirements: New-zone, touch and ranking alerts describe imbalances rather than entry confirmation. Strength bars are a model, not observed order flow or validated probability. No native position management is present.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Description includes volatility-relative gap size and candle strength in ranking. Raw qualityScore uses raw-price fvg.size*100, volume/trend scores, mitigation and age; ATR-normalized size and candle strength instead feed internal strength bars.
findings.action: Keep ranking and strength-bar formulas distinct in documentation; do not assume quality scores are volatility-normalized across symbols.

LUiMCGHl.author: Zeiierman
LUiMCGHl.summary: Rolling VWAP moves an ATR-based structure whose step blends volatility ratio and ATR Z-score through a sigmoid. A direction change re-anchors accumulated VWAP and deviation bands, defining the new value phase.
LUiMCGHl.requirements: Structure mean, price/value relationship, crosses and band touches frame trend or extension. Author supplies no automatic exit or stop/target lifecycle. Reversal events reset the value model, not a tracked trade; band contact needs reaction/context interpretation.

findings.evidence: Prior exit.has=true infers reversal of a position from the opposite structural shift. Raw source only changes direction and resets anchored VWAP sums; author describes a new value phase without a position close instruction.

reviewBlocker.blocker: Prior web tools explicitly restricted this primary author page; restriction preserved without retry or alternate access. No cached author explanation exists.

phNDYIN6.author: Zeiierman

findings.evidence: Prior timing records pivotLagBars=0 despite raw symmetric ta.pivothigh/low(pLen,pLen). Break events occur later on a price cross, but their reference pivots themselves require the configured confirmation delay.

r8j7m88J.author: Zeiierman

yzZbvyfS.author: Zeiierman
yzZbvyfS.summary: High relative volume, volume rising from the prior bar, small body/range ratio and an ATR minimum range identify indecision with participation. The map projects candle midpoint levels and optionally merges nearby levels into zones.

FRJnzpVL.author: Zeiierman
FRJnzpVL.summary: Partitions monthly, quarterly or yearly history, converts each period to cumulative percentage change from its starting price, and normalizes differing bar counts onto a shared progress axis. Historical paths, mean/median and similarity metrics contextualize the active period.
FRJnzpVL.requirements: MAE, maximum deviation, direction agreement and current-end difference compare only comparable path progress. Historical full-period overlays and visual similarity are not forecasts or trading evidence. Last-bar drawings provide no entry, stop, target or exit channel.

0mavnWxr.author: Zeiierman
0mavnWxr.summary: Cycle count times bars per cycle sets the ROC horizon. EMA smoothing precedes either clamped Z-score or rolling min/max normalization to a bounded scale, then final smoothing. Positive/negative values and movement toward extremes describe momentum regime and strength.
0mavnWxr.requirements: Zero crossings are regime changes; fear/greed threshold crossings are extremes, without a prescribed reversal or complete strategy. Require sufficient ROC and normalization warmup. Author does not prescribe opposite-cross position exits.

9HqOxhyD.author: Zeiierman
9HqOxhyD.summary: Four confirmed alternating pivots frame cup rim, depth and handle. Rim similarity, handle retracement and directional geometry qualify the pattern; optional rim-close confirmation delays detection. Projected target scales cup depth.

findings.evidence: Author describes an invalidation setting that marks broken structure. Raw invHit is calculated at the end and unused; no invalidation alert, deletion or managed stop follows. Default needConfirm=false also matters for entry interpretation.

ffwlVJmd.author: Zeiierman
ffwlVJmd.summary: A four-point ZigZag sequence defines range X-A, bounded sweep B beyond X and snapback C beyond A plus optional pad. Springs and upthrusts identify opposite-direction failed breaks.

lDxohpMZ.author: Zeiierman
lDxohpMZ.summary: Bins each bar's volume at its close, selects above-average local peaks, and spreads selected peaks with Gaussian weights. Enhanced-profile maxima/minima define POC and historical-segment VA/LV extensions; current and pivot-defined profiles are redrawn.

wvnP7tPF.author: Zeiierman

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

8owCUqFq.author: Zeiierman
8owCUqFq.summary: Assigns bar volume across price bins using selectable uniform, body/wick, point, weighted or statistical distributions. Bull/bear contributions, POC, a central cumulative-volume band and selectable heatmap metrics illustrate sensitivity to intrabar allocation assumptions.
8owCUqFq.requirements: The distributions model unknown within-bar activity rather than recover actual transactions. Last-bar drawings provide no trade signals. Q7YQQq7g.author: Zeiierman

Q7YQQq7g.requirements: Empty bins do not prove no trades occurred there: all bar volume is assigned to a single source price, omitting its other traded prices. Candle color is not transaction aggressor side. Last-bar graphics are contextual, with no native order or risk-management channel.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Author repeatedly calls empty bins true untraded prices. Raw loop assigns volume only where src[i] falls and then breaks; a bar can trade through other empty bins without assigning volume there. OHLCV cannot establish the claimed transaction-level absence.
findings.action: Reject the true-untraded interpretation; label these empty modeled bins and do not use the claim as evidence or guaranteed refill targets.

xPd1d97H.author: Zeiierman

Zone creation, inside-zone alerts and plotted upper/lower levels are context rather than executable entries.

findings.marker: Accumulation/Distribution Zone Identified; Price Inside Acc/Dist POC Zone

9ZHUV2xc.author: Zeiierman

9gJMO0yp.author: Zeiierman

pNz3hmGc.author: Zeiierman

vzKdIrEh.role: Context / dual range and candle trend
vzKdIrEh.summary: Smoothed high/low movement scaled by volatility forms adaptive range bands. Configurable moving-average families drive the main range trend and a second candle-trend engine; their alignment informs discretionary direction or reversal analysis.
vzKdIrEh.requirements: Trend-colored candles require smoothed-price placement and medium/long trend slopes. Continuous colors and bands are not entry events. No native protective stop, targets or exits exist; author confidence language does not establish trading evidence.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

CCrSqPwk.author: Zeiierman
CCrSqPwk.role: Context / fair-value slope and deviation bands
CCrSqPwk.summary: Weighted high/low methods select or blend median-price structure, then ALMA or regression smooths fair value. Deviation bands show extension and fair-value slope supplies a directional filter.
CCrSqPwk.requirements: Author advises aligned trades and optional outer-band mean reversion, not a complete entry/exit algorithm. Trend Long/Short alerts are slope transitions; any opposite-slope close is bot policy. Bands alone are not native stops or target orders.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Raw alerts report slope turning positive/negative. Prior exit.has=true infers reversing a trade despite no position tracking, while author describes slope as a filter.
findings.action: Identify these as trend transitions and remove any implied native position-exit claim.

TACtAHYh.author: Zeiierman
TACtAHYh.summary: Directional candle runs or optional smoothed momentum form unmitigated order-block zones. Estimated pressure bars and a filtered OB trendline support retest interpretation. June 2026 updates added then fixed alerts.
TACtAHYh.requirements: Creation and mitigation are zone events. Retest only marks first overlap and can coincide with mitigation/deletion, so it does not guarantee a surviving entry zone. True HTF mode has unshifted getCandle and volume with lookahead_on; default chart timeframe must be distinguished. No native risk lifecycle exists.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: getCandle uses unshifted close/open and request.security lookahead_on; volume in getMTF is also unshifted. Non-default higher-timeframe historical detection can receive future HTF completion, beyond merely live repaint.
findings.action: Do not approve HTF backtests under blanket safe timing; use a separately tested completed-HTF implementation/configuration.

findings.evidence: Cleaner flags first touched before independently checking mitigated and deleting the same zone. A retest and mitigation can therefore co-occur on one candle, contrary to interpreting retest as an unconditionally active-zone trade.
findings.action: Require a separately specified eligibility/precedence policy before automating retest entries; preserve the original source event record.

zSNlLXMM.author: Zeiierman
zSNlLXMM.summary: Median-clustered volatility selects slow or fast price/time-correlation oscillators. The chosen oscillator above/below 0.5 defines bullish/bearish regime; triangles indicate transitions and the slower/faster relationship supplies pullback context.
zSNlLXMM.requirements: Author uses shifts to confirm trend breakouts and discretionary pullbacks rather than specifying full entries or lifecycle. Markers have offset -1: knowledge belongs to the current calculation bar, not the prior displayed bar. Intrabar regime changes can disappear before close.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

53kElA60.author: Zeiierman
53kElA60.summary: Kalman-smoothed RSI and DMI/ADX strength form a momentum display. ADX at or below 20 accumulates a consolidation box; after the zone ends, the first close crossing its high or low marks an upward/downward breakout.
53kElA60.requirements: The author explicitly permits breakout markers as early entry triggers. Require a completed low-ADX zone and one breakout per zone; current low-ADX range expansion is not an entry. Source crossover calls are conditional, so exact engine parity deserves verification. No native stop/target/exit management exists.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

h4xuU8kN.author: Zeiierman
h4xuU8kN.summary: RSI crossing configured overbought/oversold thresholds restarts a growing, capped regression window after minimum warmup. A prior band excursion followed by a counter-color close back inside marks a rejection.
h4xuU8kN.requirements: Upper rejection is bearish and lower rejection bullish; RSI reset markers only re-anchor the channel. The rejection is known on the current confirming bar although displayed one bar earlier. Current specs already restrict labels to the two rejections and invert generic side mapping; preserve this correction and deduplicate UI shapes.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Raw upperReject requires prior upper cross then bearish close inside; lowerReject mirrors it. Current specs labels only these two and invert=true, correcting generic Upper=>long/Lower=>short.
findings.action: Retain existing explicit rejection interpretation and original evidence identity; do not apply another inversion or trade RSI reset/UI markers.

PwTdSQ3F.author: Zeiierman
PwTdSQ3F.role: Context / range-zone volume and fair value
PwTdSQ3F.summary: Builds separate upper/lower range volume bins, candle-color buy/sell totals and POC percentages. A moving average of the upper-zone POC supplies the drifting fair-value line used for suggested trend-aligned retests.
PwTdSQ3F.requirements: Volume labels report aggregates, not orders; candle color is a participation proxy. Author proposes discretionary retests without a defined executable trigger. The source fair-value line averages upper-zone POC only, not both zone POCs. No stop/target/exit lifecycle is present.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Raw pocPrice is ut-(pocU+0.5)*bs and avgPocPrice is its SMA; lower-zone POC is not part of this line despite broad average-POC wording in the description.
findings.action: Describe the upper-zone POC basis explicitly and retain context-only interpretation.

XOHrX8Wm.author: Zeiierman
XOHrX8Wm.summary: Combines stochastic momentum, an MA basis with ATR/stochastic-dependent bands, selectable regression projections and close-versus-basis dominance displays. Author suggests trend alignment, outer-band reversion and K/D confirmation.
XOHrX8Wm.requirements: These are discretionary combinations without entry events or lifecycle. The bands are not an exact inverse map of stochastic thresholds: basis is a moving average of close and width uses ATR plus stochastic scaling. Price crossing basis therefore need not equal stochastic crossing 50.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.marker: Stoch Basis / Upper and Lower Bands
findings.evidence: Raw basis=ma(close,bandLength,bandType); dev=ATR*(1+(50-abs(stochK-50))/100). This does not mathematically enforce the claimed price/basis equivalence to K/50 or price/band equivalence to OB/OS thresholds.
findings.action: Describe stochastic-influenced volatility bands, not an exact oscillator-to-price conversion.

5jS51RsP.author: Zeiierman
5jS51RsP.summary: Three-candle wick gaps create monitored zones with midpoint/full-fill mitigation, estimated close-position pressure bars, an active-gap table and a filtered trendline. Author uses these as confluence and directional context.
5jS51RsP.requirements: No native entry or lifecycle markers exist. Non-default HTF uses unshifted OHLCV with lookahead_on and can leak completed HTF history; lower-timeframe request.security is not complete intrabar aggregation. Pressure bars are estimates. The source sensitivity variable called wick is actually candle-body size.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: getMTF returns current close/high/low/volume and request.security uses lookahead_on. Thus the contract safe label applies only to default chart timeframe, not arbitrary HTF selection.
findings.action: Restrict timing claims to verified configuration and separately test completed-HTF semantics.

findings.evidence: getCandle computes max(close,open)-min(close,open), which is body magnitude rather than wick length.
findings.action: Document body-based impulse filtering rather than the author description's wick-size test.

ZsWZRg62.author: Zeiierman
ZsWZRg62.role: Trade setup / adaptive MA trend with stated crossover exits
ZsWZRg62.summary: Selectable slope, RSI, volume, Bollinger, MACD, stochastic, CCI or momentum conditions reset a persistence counter that adjusts MA length. Filtered trend persistence yields fresh signals; author pairs green/long or red/short entries with opposite price/MA-cross exits.
ZsWZRg62.requirements: Source titles reverse semantic direction: Trend Dn is rising-filter long; Trend Up falling-filter short. State circles and visual duplicates are not new entries. Signals are drawn one bar earlier than known. Author crossover exits need explicit engine support; opposite trend starts are not the stated exit rule.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: confirmedUptrend uses trendDown>=trending and creates downward Trend Up; confirmedDowntrend uses trendUp>=trending and creates upward Trend Dn. No default specs override exists. Generic direction names invert these intended sides.
findings.action: Check active config, then test a distinct explicit mapping Trend Dn=>long and Trend Up=>short with state/visual markers excluded.

findings.evidence: Author explicitly says close long when price crosses below dynamic MA and short above. Source plots Dynamic MA but emits no such exit event; prior contract exit.has=false omits this author requirement.
findings.action: Record author-required price/MA exits separately from signal-only behavior; require a supported, tested lifecycle before claiming author-native execution.

QkHAjRH4.author: Zeiierman
QkHAjRH4.summary: A periodic or date anchor resets cumulative price-volume and squared-price-volume sums. MIDAS is their volume-weighted mean; weighted standard deviation defines outer bands and Fibonacci ratios locate intermediate reference bands.
QkHAjRH4.requirements: Above/below MIDAS, bandwidth and outer extension provide trend/volatility context. Author offers discretionary trend/reversal tuning rather than order rules. Anchor timeframe and fixed-date availability change the reference window; zero variance can leave deviation bands undefined. No native lifecycle exists.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

EFGQPt1E.author: Zeiierman
EFGQPt1E.summary: Normalizes lookback returns between percentile-derived thresholds on a bounded scale and optionally smooths a signal line. Divergences compare new oscillator window extremes with previously recorded oscillator and price extremes.
EFGQPt1E.requirements: Bull divergence requires higher oscillator low with lower price low; bear is mirrored. These are current-window extrema rather than right-confirmed pivots. Author also discusses zero bias, extreme zones and line crosses, but those are not emitted as native entries/exits. No protective lifecycle is supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

SdMSDRLI.author: Zeiierman
SdMSDRLI.summary: Log-scaled selectable volume, price, dispersion, ATR or a gap/range volatility estimate is standardized against recent history. Columns and adaptive smoothing show relative metric deviation; plus/minus two highlights unusual regimes.
SdMSDRLI.requirements: These regimes are nondirectional and may accompany continuation, reversal or future expansion. No order markers or lifecycle exist. The implemented smoothing length increases with absolute Z-score, opposite the description's claimed shorter, faster smoothing for strong deviations.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Raw dynamic_length=smoothing_length+int(abs(scaled_volatility)*2), then alpha=2/(length+1). Greater absolute deviation therefore lengthens smoothing and reduces alpha rather than shortening it.
findings.action: Correct smoothing description to actual behavior; do not infer greater responsiveness during extreme deviations.

YUAV6jit.author: Zeiierman
YUAV6jit.role: Context / adaptive trend and wave statistics
YUAV6jit.summary: Adaptive EMA and acceleration parameters frame direction; smoothed candle-body changes accumulate into wave speed. Completed bull/bear waves supply average/max comparisons and dominance ratios, optionally limited by a start date.
YUAV6jit.requirements: Histogram acceleration, wave ratios and dominance describe momentum rather than order timing. Close-versus-dynamic-MA transitions reset wave statistics but are not exported trade entries. Ratios are not probabilities or evidence approval, and no native stop/target/exit lifecycle exists.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

fFINieF9.author: Zeiierman
fFINieF9.role: Context / Kalman trend and sigma bands
fFINieF9.summary: A two-state price/velocity Kalman framework smooths observations with selectable standard, volume-adjusted or range-adjusted measurement noise. A second filter, bands, trend strength and confidence displays support trend/reversion analysis.
fFINieF9.requirements: Colors, strength percentages and projected confidence boxes are model context, not win probabilities or trade events. Author allows multiple competing uses of sigma-band touches/expansion; independent setup and risk rules are required. No native entries or protective lifecycle is provided.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

PDi6enZR.author: Zeiierman
PDi6enZR.summary: Price and local-change states are recursively filtered; the local-change component is normalized against recent absolute extremes and smoothed into a signed strength oscillator. Standard, volume or range-adjusted noise variants alter response.
PDi6enZR.requirements: Positive/negative strength conveys direction, while blue transitions and plus/minus 70 extremes can mean pullback or reversal. Percentage display is normalized oscillator magnitude, not probability. The source emits continuous plots and a table without executable entries or lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

mE6LGQLx.author: Zeiierman
mE6LGQLx.summary: ATR-based adaptive bands curve with elapsed trend movement and their midpoint supplies trend reference. Relative close position times normalized channel width gives a signed strength measure and rolling extrema.
mE6LGQLx.requirements: Band breaks, midpoint reactions and strength are discretionary context, with no order events. Max/min are signed mathematical extrema; the description's comparison of minimum exceeding maximum cannot be used literally. Flat range denominators can also leave strength undefined.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Raw maxTrendStrength=highest(trendStrength) and minTrendStrength=lowest(trendStrength). The author's suggested Min>Max bearish test cannot hold for two defined extrema from the same window.
findings.action: Use signed strength and correctly interpreted extrema; do not create a trade rule from the impossible comparison.

Qkn8MlX0.author: Zeiierman
Qkn8MlX0.role: Manual setups / curved structure and transition statistics
Qkn8MlX0.summary: Curved boundaries produce CHoCH direction changes then SMS/BMS continuation states. Author examples require trend pullbacks to midrange or reversal sequence confirmation, with structural stops and premium/discount targets.
Qkn8MlX0.requirements: Those examples are distinct discretionary strategies, not every structure label as entry. Stated stops, targets and optional CHoCH exit are not managed native orders. The displayed win/profitability statistics count structure-transition predictions, not priced trade returns, costs or funded risk outcomes.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Probability Calculation increments results on pos state transitions and compares stored transition probabilities. It never evaluates trade entry price, exit price, risk, fees or the example strategy stops/targets.
findings.action: Label transition-frequency statistics explicitly; do not import them as bot profitability evidence or native strategy validation.

findings.marker: Midrange / recent swing stop and premium-discount target
findings.evidence: Author examples specify these entry/stop/target choices; raw source only draws structure/ranges and updates pos. Existing source stop/targets false correctly means no executable lifecycle, not absence of author requirements.
findings.action: Keep manual strategy choices separate; require explicit tested entry, structural protection and target support before author-native execution.

rbNId5zr.author: Zeiierman
rbNId5zr.summary: Tracks confirmed pivots and CHoCH/SMS/BMS states across selectable symbols, with premium/discount/midrange context and batched ticker-qualified alerts. Author offers pullback, structural reversal and reaction-based examples.
rbNId5zr.requirements: Alerts can concern other symbols and must not open the chart symbol blindly. Preserve ticker identity and pivot availability; the default enables five symbols among twenty configurable inputs. Labels and premium/discount occupancy remain context without native stops or exits.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Prior contract says five hard-coded stocks, but raw uses input.symbol across twenty slots with five enabled by default. Each alert prefixes the originating ticker and the final output joins them.
findings.action: Document configurable multi-symbol scope and prohibit collapsing a batched external-symbol alert into a chart-symbol entry.

LjuoM8aq.author: Zeiierman
LjuoM8aq.summary: Plots hourly/four-hour opens, an hourly average, extremes and projected HTF candles. Optional retest triangles mark zone/line revisits with a per-hour limit and optional volume filter. Author additionally proposes sweep and equal-level examples.
LjuoM8aq.requirements: Intended chart resolution is one or five minutes. Retests default off; enabling them is a strategy configuration choice. Untitled triangle direction matters. Unshifted lookahead-on HTF OHLC feeds drawings, while prior-close requests are shifted; do not indiscriminately treat drawing leakage as retest leakage. No native stop or exit rules exist.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

S0c57GlJ.author: Zeiierman
S0c57GlJ.summary: Reads TradingView analyst target and recommendation fields, draws highest/lowest targets and an average/median range, and summarizes buy/hold/sell counts.
S0c57GlJ.requirements: These are external analyst opinions for supported stocks, not native technical entries, bot take-profits or performance evidence. Missing symbol fields remain unavailable; last-bar displays cannot serve as point-in-time historical backtest signals. No trade lifecycle exists.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

i7W5HFQh.author: Zeiierman
i7W5HFQh.summary: Calculates rolling volume-weighted price, applies a Fourier transform component and plots volatility/deviation bands. Author suggests lower-band entries in uptrends, upper-band entries in downtrends and optional opposite-band or harmonic-divergence exits.
i7W5HFQh.requirements: The source exports reference plots, not explicit entry, divergence or exit events. Trend qualification, exact touch and exit choices require a separately specified strategy; do not claim native management from the band drawings. The Fourier-transformed series is visually hidden by default.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

MDtuDzTh.author: Zeiierman
MDtuDzTh.summary: Combines close minus an EMA of true range with lookback price displacement, then smooths the average and surrounds it with normal/expanded Bollinger bands. Author describes trend, extension, breakout, reversion and divergence uses.
MDtuDzTh.requirements: Those uses can imply opposing directions; no single band event is a complete entry rule. Source subtracts a volatility series rather than the closing-price average described in prose. This original oscillator emits plots/fills only; the later Overlay publication's alert logic must not be assumed here.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Description says closing price minus a moving average of closes adjusted for volatility. Raw volAdjPrice is EMA(trueRange), and priceDelta=close-volAdjPrice, blended with close-close[length].
findings.action: Document the literal implemented arithmetic; keep original plot-only and later overlay-alert variants distinct.

p5gGWHl5.author: Zeiierman
p5gGWHl5.summary: Swing recency or chosen bias selects direction; automatic median swing distance, pivot or percentage methods define trailing boundaries. A live risk/reward box and required break-even win rate use current close as a hypothetical entry. May 2026 updates Pine version.
p5gGWHl5.requirements: Break-even curve is a required win-rate relationship, not an instruction to amend a real stop to entry. Opposite boundary supplies hypothetical reward, not a filled target. Both plots share TSL title, requiring side-aware disambiguation. Native protective trailing requires engine support; no actual position is tracked.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Two TSL plots expose longtsl and shorttsl. Risk/reward and minimum win rate are recomputed from current close on last bar; there is no tracked fill or break-even-stop amendment.
findings.action: Keep hypothetical risk planning separate from execution and profitability evidence; require explicit side/plot selection and tested stop management for any native variant.

znmwwlYD.author: Zeiierman
znmwwlYD.summary: Modified ATR/supertrend and HMA-based smoothing produce dynamic support/resistance and a trailing cloud. Color changes describe direction; 2024 update fixes color and April 2026 update describes smoother filtering without precise parameters.
znmwwlYD.requirements: The author presents trend and dynamic support/resistance interpretation, not executable stop amendments or exits. Source Smart Trailing is a plot and deliberately gaps at direction changes. Prior stop/exit claims are reference interpretations, not a supported native lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Source plots trailing value only when direction persists across consecutive bars and emits no exit event. Author does not specify the exact position-close rule inferred by exit.has=true.
findings.action: Describe trailing reference only; any price-cross/flip exit or stop order requires an explicit separately tested policy.

ZSyG0zv6.author: Zeiierman
ZSyG0zv6.role: Trade setup / adaptive MA filtered signals
ZSyG0zv6.summary: Efficiency ratio controls Kaufman-style smoothing. Gamma-adjusted prior-AMA crossings, cooldown and optional candle-trend agreement generate Buy/Sell events. Trend-change alerts and AMA candles provide context; updates note color and performance changes.
ZSyG0zv6.requirements: Use actual Buy/Sell signals, not every Positive/Negative Trend change. Gamma changes trend/reversal behavior. UI shapes duplicate the same events and must not create extra entries; candle-trend filtering is optional. Marker offsets are cosmetic, not protective levels. No native stops, targets or exits exist.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.marker: UI - Buy Signal / UI - Sell Signal
findings.evidence: Prior contract lists these as entries, but raw UI shapes have the same displaySignal conditions as the main Buy/Sell shapes and only different size/transparency.
findings.action: Treat UI variants as duplicate visualization and emit one entry event per substantive signal.

aaPsyqft.author: Zeiierman
aaPsyqft.summary: Visible-range extremes anchor a percentage grid, fan, curves and angles; reverse/extend settings alter the drawing. Author proposes discretionary support/resistance and forecast interpretation.
aaPsyqft.requirements: The viewport changes anchors, so drawings are not fixed historical signal evidence. Forecast geometry is not validated prediction. Raw breakout alerts compare price against horizontal bar-coordinate values instead of price levels, so their advertised breakout meaning is unsupported.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: x0 is selected from high/low bar locations and x stores interpolated integer horizontal coordinates. Alert expressions compare low/high with x0 and x.get(i), mixing price with bar index instead of y-levels.
findings.action: Do not use these alerts as price-level breakouts. Any correction must be an independently tested source variant with viewport dependence resolved.

6Io0v2PL.author: Zeiierman
6Io0v2PL.summary: On daily bars, simulates calendar-day purchases using initial capital, monthly contributions and integer shares, then compares shares, cost and transaction counts with a randomized monthly selection.
6Io0v2PL.requirements: This is retrospective analysis, not entry signals or future evidence. The random comparator is nonreproducible without a fixed seed. Source price storage is not cleared monthly and writes the new month's first open before settling prior data, so missing-day and period-boundary handling need validation before using rankings.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: days column 3 persists across months without a reset; days.set(dayofmonth-1,3,open) runs before month-change processing. Thus a prior-month simulation can mix the new month's first open and stale prices for nontrading dates.
findings.action: Do not treat best-day or random-comparator tables as reliable evidence until calendar state and contribution handling are independently tested.

mqCV52bc.author: Zeiierman
mqCV52bc.summary: Aggregates open-to-close daily returns by calendar day/weekday and period returns by week/month. Tables show historical averages and bullish/bearish frequency context for optional seasonal analysis.
mqCV52bc.requirements: Requires daily timeframe and raises an error otherwise. The label Edge is a retrospective statistic, not an approved bot edge, causal effect or prospective win probability. Period sample size and calendar handling matter; no executable entries, risk or lifecycle rules are supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

78AVOLmR.author: Zeiierman
78AVOLmR.summary: Builds a user-timed opening high/low, maps smoothed rolling volume into a range-relative activity measure, and qualifies upward/downward close crossings with activity above its average and threshold. Updates mention performance and Pine v6.
78AVOLmR.requirements: Preserve timezone/session configuration. PMMV is rolling chart-bar volume, not an empirical same-minute-across-days profile. Shapes add cooldown and display gating; alerts use raw crossings. These are distinct readings. Break Dn is short semantically; default reader vocabulary and active overrides must be respected. No native stop/target/exit lifecycle exists.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: SignalUp/SignalDn apply conditionloop, while alertconditions directly use breakUp/breakDn. Author activity requirement is present in both, but alert frequency differs from displayed signals.
findings.action: Keep shape versus raw-alert behavior explicit and preserve measured reader identities; do not assume channel equivalence.

1cAMZFft.author: Zeiierman
1cAMZFft.summary: Confirmed pivot breaks combined with an intact opposing extreme create order-block/imbalance boxes and BOS annotations. The May 2026 update adds BOS levels. Author treats zones as possible revisit/confluence areas rather than literal no-trade gaps.
1cAMZFft.requirements: Respect symmetric pivot delay and backdated drawings. Source bullish condition retains a stored low at or below recent lows; bearish retains a stored high at or above recent highs, rather than requiring a new extreme on the breakout bar. BOS/zone creation has no defined entry, stop, target or exit.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Raw bullish locross is close crossing stored high while stored lo<=lowest(low,prd); bearish is mirrored. This validates an unbroken opposing extreme rather than a mandatory new lower low/higher high on the break.
findings.action: Describe exact stored-extreme test and keep inferred imbalance zones separate from executed entries.

bHD78pHs.author: Zeiierman
bHD78pHs.summary: Golden Swap seeks shallow countertrend liquidity sweeps followed by renewed prior momentum near reference levels. Filters select symmetry, baseline bounds and optional pin bars. Updates add alerts and merge nearby reference labels.
bHD78pHs.requirements: Use completed Long/Short events; preliminary marks are context. Reference-level confluence remains discretionary. Selected signal timeframe and chart-timeframe filters must be distinguished; no native stop or target.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Source fetches selectable tf OHLC at 175, indexes its expanded series at 177–178, but filters and final close comparison use chart bars. Prior contract incorrectly says all entry logic uses chart timeframe.
findings.action: Constrain default chart timeframe or implement and test explicit mixed-timeframe semantics before alternate-tf approval.

9FUcuda3.author: Zeiierman
9FUcuda3.summary: Bloom combines opposite-color engulfing, baseline close placement and matching extremes. Precision PinBar combines top/bottom-third bodies with baseline and symmetry. Author recommends support/resistance confluence; updates add alerts and merged labels.
9FUcuda3.requirements: Pattern direction is explicit, but reference-level proximity is manual. Preserve optional display controls separately from alerts. PinBar formula does not require a three-times tail in every case. No native lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Prose describes a long tail at least three times the body; raw 167–168 permits bullish/bearish body color instead via OR. Shared tailLen measures the lower tail even for bearish logic.
findings.action: Describe actual formula and avoid treating the prose wick criterion as implemented.

eETJcnc8.author: Zeiierman
eETJcnc8.summary: Daily equity dashboard aggregates dividend amounts, shares, custom payout months and historical growth, optionally estimating future distributions. No updates are published.
eETJcnc8.requirements: Dividend calendar and alerts are portfolio information, not entry signals. Separate estimates and manual amounts from actual announcements; daily FactSet availability and currency govern outputs.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Author presents Ex-Date versus Actual Payout day. Raw 395 simply assigns payout to the following month for non-Ex-Date; it does not request an actual payment date.
findings.action: Label this an approximate month shift; do not use it as an authoritative payout schedule or trading trigger.

O5tcQ17r.author: Zeiierman
O5tcQ17r.summary: Tracks open-versus-previous-close gaps in percentage buckets, counts fills and average elapsed bars, and draws active/all gaps. Author explains possible gap interpretations without prescribing entries; update says minor changes only.
O5tcQ17r.requirements: New Bull/Bear gap and fill alerts are descriptive. Filling requires reaching the previous close, not any partial move into the gap. Fill statistics are historical counts, not win rates.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Raw 113–115 and 140–142 require the far gap boundary (previous close), stricter than prose saying price moves back into gap area.
findings.action: Keep informational and define full-gap closure precisely; no automatic trade from direction words.

ZrEdJ42P.author: Zeiierman
ZrEdJ42P.summary: Adaptive trend and volatility bands describe direction, compression and possible extremes. Settings control responsiveness and scalping behavior; the only update adds a license.
ZrEdJ42P.requirements: Use slope and band width as context. No crossings are emitted as entries or exits. Band touches do not prescribe reversals.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.
